She definitely know what she is talking about and her lectures are very interesting and involved.  The assigned reading is usually very relevant but can sometimes be hard to get through due to its monotony.  Even though she gives out good review sheets, the tests are extremely picky and she wants you to regurgitate what she says in lecture.
Prof Warren is a great lady.  Her lectures are interesting.  Nice overlap of lecture, reading material, paper assignments, and discussion.  Not too hard.  I liked the class.

Professor Warren knows almost everything about religion, so her lectures are usually really interesting.  The discussion section is boring, but helpful for tests.  You get a review sheet for the tests and exam so you know exactly what will be on it.  Also, you ALWAYS get out late, so don't schedule a class right after this one.  Go to class!!!!

Her class, though the material could have been very boring, was very interesting and intriguing. She really knows how to bring religious history to life. She played music and all of that which made it much easier to pay attention and get lost in all the historical facts. The tests are a bit picky, but she gives out a GREAT study guide before hand.

I liked Prof. Warren, she's really funny.She plays music and sings in class,sutff like the Beatles and Bob Dylan and a lot of stuff like that.She gives a lot of useless info but she gives you the exam b4 time so you just have to memorize it.3 papers (2nd WR) 7 pgs each,not too bad, you can do a re-write if you get a C.Runs over a lot,GOOD CLASS!

the subject matter was interesting, though professor warren's delivery of it was not; she was very helpful one-on-one, however. multiple choice quizzes (2) are very easy but midterm and final are crazy;she is extremely picky about your responses and doesn't really specify what she wants. also she doesn't post the notes so u have to come to class!!

This class was so agrivating. The lecture detail and presentation were on a middle school level, so lecture was simplistic and dull. However, the testing was presented and graded in a completely different manner than any class I've ever taken. Getting a good grade has nothing to do with learning or analyzing but complete regurgitation of the review

This class is A LOT of information.  She really loves her subject so she tends to talk pretty fast and it is amazing how much information she can fit into one lecture.  Classes tend to run a few mins late.  Exams are easy - she gives you the lay out like a few weeks prior and basically long as you do that you will do fine in teh class!!

She tends to run over a little on her lectures so you might not want to schedule another class directly after hers unless its close by. Tons of reading, but I got an A and read less than 1/4 of the material. Skim enough of it to be familiar with it for discussion because it is 25% of the grade.

Prof. Warren was alright. I found her to be pretty boring and just not that clear about everything. She  cares way too much about specific dates. There were 2 10-question multiple choice quizes, a midterm and final (for midterm and final she gave us review sheets of everything that could be on them)

The class was not as easy as I was expecting it to be, but it definitely could've been worse.  There was a TON of reading though.  A lot depends on how good your ta is.  Mine wasn't good at all, which made things harder.  Prof Warren kept the class interesting and was very funny.

Typical big lecture class. She gives a copy of the mid-term and final several days before the tests. Definitely not hard to get a good grade if you get a TA who doesnt expect alot. It was a pretty interesting material in class. Not much work at all.
class is interesting but way too difficult for a 101 level course

She was interesting and informative. I really enjoyed the class despite the somewhat boring lecture, but she does her best. There's a lot of reading, but she gives you out a copy of the mid term and final before you take it so you have the opportunity to do really well. I'd def. recommend it!
Prof Warren is great!  She is one professor who truly cares about her students.  Several millenia of religion is not something that one can easily make exciting, but she does her best.

class sucked pretty bad. prof warren is pretty wierd, which can make class a little entertaining at times, but usually it was pretty boring, her grading style was horrendous and she puts the most mundane, stupid stuff on tests/quizzes. not recommended.

She doesnt dress up or sing like people said before, and she's really not that interesting. She talks super fast, the class was often really boring, and theres a ton of reading. Discussions are helpful however.
she makes class interesting even when the topic is boring
mrs. warren likes to sing, play music and wear clothes that relate to topics.  great teacher.  lots of reading, but she lets you know what is important,
Very interesting class, not too hard.  I warn you though there is a lot of reading.

One of the most benevolent professors at the University. Her class is extremely interesting and you learn a wide variety of things. Emphasis on your papers - can be tough. Revise, revise, revise. She's amazing, though.
Wonderful professor, plays acoustic guitar in class

Professor Ma is one of the sweetest professors here. She is incredibly caring and willing to help in the case of different circumstances. Her lectures are very clear and she is willing to listen to questions and take time to explain. Her office hours helped a ton and she is very approachable.

Professor Ma was extremely kind and caring, and tried her best in the class. Her lectures were good and often gave some time to work on group homework. The weekly checkpoints weren't too bad but make sure to be prepared as one little mistake will crush your checkpoint hopes and dreams, though you get 3 attempts per checkpoint to try again.
Hui Ma is the best professor I have ever had. Her lectures make the material super easy to understand. Also, she is very understanding and cares about your learning.

Professor Ma is great! Her lectures take you step-by-step and help you understand the material. The grading system she uses is a little confusing at times and can be frustrating; however, if you understand the material, it shouldn't be a problem. Aside from the academics, she is very sweet and very approachable. She truly cares for her students.
Professor Ma is the best professor I had at UVA so far. She was so sweet and respectful to every student. Her explanations are clear and helpful. I 100% recommend taking calculus with her.
She is an amazing and caring professor with easy to follow lectures
She the GOAT. End of discussion.

If you are in the E-school and have the opportunity to have Professor Ma, take her class! She cares for her students and actually wants you to learn, not just pass the class. Her mastery grading system is great too.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Her lectures are so well organized, and she makes sure students understand before moving on. The tests are not too hard as long as you do the homework. Also, she really cares about her students. I will definitely take her class again!

Great professor with concise lectures. Explains information and content very well and would highly recommend. Takes great effort in making sure content is understood. Homework is quite a lot but it's manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Manageable workload and great lectures. Absolutely fantastic professor who really works to make sure you comprehend the content thoroughly. Would take another one of her classes in an instant.

Class isn't easy, but Hui Ma REALLY cares about her students and helping them succeed. I had an issue with the teaching style and talked to her about it. By the next day, she had slightly shifted her teaching style in a way that was far more effective. Worth going to her office hours and talking to if you're struggling.
best math lecturer I've had. very understandable and teaches concepts in a thorough but manageable way that I really appreciate. don't feel like I have to teach myself!

I took APMA 1110 with Hui Ma and I am very thankful I did. She was awesome and really explained how to do the problems. She is the type of professor who doesn't like to waste time with proofs. She did examples through the whole lecture which I personally enjoy. Calc 2 is not an easy class by any means but taking it with Hui Ma is a good first step.

She's an angel of a professor. Super nice and super fun to talk to. She does a lot of problems in class so you understand the material and really cares if you understand the concepts or not. She is the best professor for Calc 2 in my opinion.

Hui Ma is one of the best math teachers I've ever had. Her classes are structured where you are discussing topics with your peers more than listening to a lecture. She is very effective in teaching and is very understanding. Make sure you do homework and stay up to date with reading assignments because classes are rooted in participation.
Best math professor at UVA!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: After having a terrible experience with the APMA department my first semester, Hui Ma is a savior sent from heaven. She is so far my favorite teacher on grounds and really cares about her students learning.
She is a great math professor, she really engages the students and will repeat a topic as many times as necessary.

Everyone sleeps on Hui Ma because she is fairly new to UVA, but she is easily one of the best math teachers I have ever had. She teaches very comprehensibly and conveys concepts very clearly, exactly how you need to know them for the exams. Although she has an accent, it is not hard to understand her. I would definitely take another class with Ma.
Great content, Great class, Great guy. Take his class for many laughs and some inspiring life stories.
Hard to understand sometimes but genuinely nice guy and gives out a lot of extra credit in the class.

Arguably the worst professor/teacher I have ever had. Completely incapable of relaying information clearly. Changed the grading policy in the middle of the semester. Avoid any class with him if you can.

Where do I start? His section is a mandatory 9am MWF for mechs and he gives pop quizzes. He randomly calls on students in class, changes the course grading policy every week (eg he put in clickers half way through the semester), and he is hands down the worst lecturer I have ever has the displeasure of learning from.

Richard Handler is one of the greats for sure. I think if anyone has the opportunity to take one of his classes they should as he is one of the most brilliant minds at UVA. That being said his unchecked political posturing and nearly non-stop political speeches during this previous election cycle really scandalized me It is completely inappropriate
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took his class about museums and he's definitely one of my best professors. Really intriguing lectures, very humorous and caring personality. I love his vibe!!

He has a pretty liberal view and isn't afraid to talk ab it (esp in fall 2024 since it was election year). He encourages you to ask questions and speak your opinion. 

The work wasn't that hard. You had to do readings but he knows no one reads them so he gave his notes on the readings. Read his notes, pay attention, and you'll get an A

Regardless of what anyone says, Richard Handler is one of the greatest professors at UVA. Nearly everyone from my Intro Anth class came out of it either wanting to be an Anth major or wanting to take more classes in the department. He is hilarious, honest, and actually cares about what he is saying. His exams are easy and the exams are easy/short.
Perfect, sooooooo nice
He is very funny and entertaining. I think he prepares you well for every test. Favorite class of this semester.

One of the best professors I've had at UVA. He has strong opinions but encourages diverse thought and discussion in class. My favorite parts of the class are when the lectures turn into discussions from different perspectives. He's funny and has a lot of life experience to share. Would recommend it to anyone needing an elective.

He wants you to think exactly how he does. One person's feedback for her essay was "this is a good essay but not what we are looking for" Got a B. so even if you have a good essay, they don't care. He's also rude and condescending. He emailed my friend to stop "nagging" about grades when collab gradebook was glitching and she asked for extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: By the end of this class, I learned interesting things, but it just didn't feel like it mattered. Maybe that's because I'm not an anthro person, but it just didn't really feel that important tbh. You're only graded on essays really. The texts are sometimes boring, but Handler is p good at explaining.

Professor Handler is a great guy to know. This course was about advising rather than an actual workload. However, we had thought provoking conversations about college throughout the semester. I would take one of his actual courses in a heartbeat.

Very engaging. Offers opportunities for students to argue and push conceptual boundaries. Course material itself interesting. Very approachable and own passion for subject made me more interested as well.

Like one of the other comments mentioned, he is the epitome of white liberalism. He uses racial slurs even after students of color have asked him not to. That class was just uncomfortable for me to sit in. Also felt like he just lectured whatever came to his head without any proper thought. Would not recommend his class. Save your time and energy.

Always had engaging lectures but definitely not as socially aware as we'd all like to believe--has used racial slurs in class and seems to believe his brand of white liberalism to be the only right worldview. Still a fairly good professor and the class is pretty easy, just don't know if I could handle taking another class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Extremely mindblowing, straightforward

BEST CLASS. He's so nice. Doesn't believe in structured exams or quizzes, so the only grades are short papers which I thought were very easy and opinion-based. Final exam was take home and it was a breeze. He is very liberal and respects everyone's opinion. Was the only class i enjoyed my first year at UVA. Convinced me to be a Global Studies major

This class was a big lecture that required 3 papers (1 to be dropped or not written) so I could have taken better advantage of his office hours. When it came time for papers to be due  he was always there to answer questions through e-mail. His liberal view was very clear in this class and provided a hilarious channel for discussion.

ANTH 1010 was probably the easiest and most beneficial class that I have taken at UVA thus far. Professor Handler is very eloquent and challenges the social norm of thinking. Do take this class! It's very easy to pull off at least an A-.
Wonderful lectures, learned a lot.
he is obnoxious and rude and does not know much about anthropology
Best Professor. He sat and worked with me, so I could improve my composition skills! I learned more from him than from my English instructors.
Best professor I had at UVa.  A true individual...paradigm shifting if you really pay attention.
anth 101 is a sweet class. take it.

Fantastic man! Absolutely wonderful. However I think it helps to be an anthropology major. ALWAYS goes off topic, but always very interesting facts. Does swear. Does say things just to make people angry. But will always answer the classes questions. You either completely love him and think he's a genius, or hate him and think he's a ****.
Fantastic professor. Not always necessarily on topic, but always interesting. Great class!

please. handler's class sucked and we all knew it. incoherent babbling about NOTHING at all...you'll end up facebooking the entire time. and the quizzes! what a joke. didn't matter what you wrote, but if you got an easy or hard TA. this was BY FAR the worst class i had all semester. ratemyprofs, my bible, lead me astray on this one...
the man. that's all.

this man is the tightest teacher ive come across. drug references, cusses like a sailor, and encourages arguing in class. should attend class to absorb terms to use in the quizzes, take this class you'll either have fun or a lot of free time to play tetris

Hmm, do I even have words to describe how AMAZING he is!!!  By far the best professor I've ever come across....I true genius and a very nice man too!! His classes will open your eyes to aspects of American life you've never thought about....TAKE HIM!
Handler is just AMAZING and nice. His classes are just mind blogging, but his arguments makes sense. It is a very worthwhile class and the best class I had so far at UVA.
Hands down, greatest professor I've ever had. This class seriously changed my life. I'm obsessed with Handler- take any class he's teaching. The work load was very reasonable, and grading is fair.

**** Handler is one of the best profs at U.Va.  I had absolutely zero interest in the subject and I still went to class all the time b/c he is so entertaining and I learned a ton.  Take 101 with him--it's worth it.

The best class i've taken at uva so far.  Really makes you think about racism in America in a different way.  Conservatives flee after the 1st class so get on the waitlist if you're interested.  Easy to get at least an A-.

Handler is the best professor I've had at UVA. He's insanely hilarious and brilliant at the same time. Just do the readings and go to class. I would just go to class anyway because his lectures are so informative. Grading isn't too bad. The class is pretty intimate for having 250 people and he's very receptive to questions and interaction.
He was an awesome teacher. absolutely no interest in the topic going in, makes it easy and fun. Makes you think alot too, but the class isnt hard
pretty easy.

I can't complain about a class I never went to (except quiz days) yet still pulled off an A.  Definitely go for the discussion section, it's basically a freebie.  Not quite as awesome as I expected, but still pretty cool.
lovely human
Never thought I'd get into Anth before taking Handler's class.  Handler's the man.

Handler is the man. Everyone should basically take this awesome class as he changes the way you think about society. He makes you see the problematic structure of the nationalist ideology for example, and also talks about race and diversity very interestingly. You will gasp at the end of every lecture because this guy just simply rocks. A must take
Great teacher, funny, and very interesting.

Amazing. Awesome professor. So funny, basically give you all the information you need to know in lecture but do the readings anyway. I would take another class by him, no matter the context. Made me consider becoming an anthropology major.
Took Race, Nationalism and Multiculturalism, after taking 101 with him. One of, if not my favorite professors, at UVA.

Beyond amazing--he's my idol, if anything for his not giving a crap what anyone thinks.  He will change your view of the world--I took the class 2 years ago and it's still affecting me, I'm still engaging in the concepts of that class.  Reason I am an Anthropology major.

Handler is bloody amazing! He will change the way you understand the world in so many ways! The most meaningful class I have ever taken at U.Va. Reading is not overbearing and you will be drawn to attend every lecture. Handler is like intellectual crack--but it's GOOD for you!

If you're a conservative who is afraid to have your views challenged, then stay away. But as professor Handler always says: you've come to this school to be challenged. So if you're up for it, be prepared to have your world turned upside down.
He is amazing.  If you want a class and teacher that will challenge your entire view of the world, here it is.
This guy blows.  Period.  Don't take his class if you are right-thinking at all.

This man is the reason I declared the Anthrpology major. Whether you love him or hate him, you just can't get enough. Do yourself a favor and give him the opportunity to change the way you think about the world.
I loved having Prof. Handler, he was provactive and an engaging speaker.  I really encourage people to take his class.

Professor Handler is extraordinary!  He's brilliant--just listen to him for 15 minutes and he'll tell you something that changes the way you think.  225 was AMAZING--it will be VERY hard to beat that class while I'm here.  Take it!  Or ANYTHING by Handler.
Amazing.
ONE OF MY FAVORITE PROFS. Brilliant, hilarious, left-wing nutcase. A bit intimidating one-on-one, nonetheless extremely honest, kind and helpful. Completely changes your thinking and humbles you.

GREAT CLASS!! loved it. slightly repetative but very entertaining professor. Absolutly loved him. very liberal and outspoken, but honest about it. take this class, you won't regret it, best class i've taken at UVa!!!
Everyone should take this class with Handler (Nationalism, Racism, and Multicultrualism).  In fact there should just be more classes like this and more professors like him.

His class is really interesting and really relevent to issues today.  It will give you a new perspective on the world.  I don't recommend this class for conservatives who don't like to hear arguements against their beliefs.  Handler is VERY liberal and not afraid to say what he thinks.

Best class I have taken at UVa so far.  Gives you a new perspective of races and predjudice, very eye-opening.  Lectures can become drawn-out, but are necessary in highlighting key aspects of readings for essays and are mostly entertaining. Great material, great class.
His class is great - it is greatly relevant to day to day situations in life. His tangents are funny too.

Handler is an amazing professor. Not only is he brilliant and interesting, but he is humerous, nice, and will do just about anything to help you with your grade. I was struggling, and he tried extremely hard to make sure I received individual attention in a class of several hundred students.

Handler: intelligent, thoughtful, humorous, spastic, energetic, enlightening, passionate. Amazing guy, amazing class. This isnt a class on knowledge, its a class on life- something everyone should take...and he is what makes the class.

an AMAZING man!! He has really opened my eyes to a lot of issues. Go to lecture, the important points of the reading become obvious. It can get a little monotonous sometimes, he's at his best  when he goes off on a tangent.
With a name like Dick Handler, how can you not like him?
Handler is one of the best professors I've ever had! Very approachable, humorous, enlightening, and inspiring.
definitly will not waste your tuition, so long as you can handle the extreme liberal flavor - but it ads a nice spice
the dude is awesome.
i mean honestly   who can take a guy with the name "dick handler" serious   very intelligent but very, very liberal    any people aspiring to go into big business definitely skip out on this class
I love this man. Take him any way you can, one of the most "with-it" profs I've ever had!

Not only is this man adorbale to watch lecture, he really is a very intelligent man. His opinions are often very strong, but he speaks so well that there is rarely opposititon. He really makes you think, the readings are well picked, and tests are fair.
Very interesting class. Reading isn't too bad and if you go and pay attention to the lectures the reading isn't entirely necessary.

Wonderful lectures help you open your eyes to the world or at least articulate views on culture in a new way.  The reading is quite manageable which means you get way more out of it.  He has a great personality and is one of the wisest profs here.

Ridiculously easy class, but it's super interesting so that makes up for it.  If you never go to class, you'll still pass easily but you're missing out on a great lecturer.  Plus he's so jaded and bitter it becomes hilarious.

Prof. Handler is the best professor I've ever taken a class from. He offers an important perspective - especially on issues of race. Despite what one reviewer wrote, he IS a nice person one on one - he just has a slightly unusual personality. GREAT PROF!

I really enjoy this class even though it is a lot of work.  Professor Handler will challenge and maybe even change the way you think about culture and society.  Don't take a discussion, they don't really help at all.  The readings get a little monotonous!
funny name
Not a very nice individual in person

Very interesting lecturer.  Intelligently discusses issues from all sides(including his own VERY liberal viewpoint)and enjoys challenging stereotypes.  Not the easiest class in the world, but definitely worth the effort.

Interesting for the first few lectures, but afterwards lectures get really repetitive. I wouldn't recommend taking a discussion section with any of Handler's classes -- just talk to him in class or go to office hours if you want to talk.
No Comments
No Comments

This was the first EGMT course I took, and it was amazing! I took "Should People Be Wealthy", and Prof. Mullins valued discussions and philosophical outlooks in class. Required readings twice a week, but content was manageable and easy to understand. Discussion is not mandatory, but he does talk a lot during class. Very chill professor and great!

I took "Should People Be Wealthy?" and loved it. Ironically, it was very democratic. Professor Mullins is a great lecturer and wants students to not only do well academically but also deeply understand the world around you. He gives long readings, but also understands that we have other commitments. He grades generously and provides clear rubrics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Thought he did a great job, very cool guy, would take another class with him

One of my favorite professors! He uploads recorded lectures and powerpoints onto collab and is very passionate about sociology. So understanding and all the lectures are take home and not difficult - but help you understand the material even more. I'm choosing to minor in soc because of him and I highly recommend taking a class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love Professor Mullins! He has a clear passion for sociology; it's hard not to feel interested and invested when he is so much so. There are plenty of readings but they are all meaningful and insightful. Professor Mullins is open to feedback and really cares about his students. Highly recommend!!
Very nice and great lecturer!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mullins is the BEST. He truly cares about his students. He has structured his course in a way that allows everyone to perform equitably during the pandemic. He has a real passion for sociology. Exams were straightforward and open note/book. You read 3 books, write 3 survey questions with a group, and take 2 exams. He is just amazing.
professor mullins speaks in a monotone but the material he teaches is very interesting and he cares a lot about sociology and his students

My absolute favorite UVA professor! He's always available outside of class and you can tell he genuinely cares about the wellbeing of his students. He gives AMAZING lectures that really make you think. I added sociology as a second major after taking a course with him because I enjoyed it so much. I've taken a few classes with him now & he's 10/10!

I took Social Problems with Mullins in Spring 2020. Sociology isn't really my subject, however I feel like I learned a lot in this class. I was very impressed with how he responded to the Covid-19 crisis and how we moved online, however. Easily the most accommodating professor I had at the time and showed how he genuinely cares about his students.

I tried so hard to take him seriously but he really does lecture like he's giving a TED talk-- the class felt like more of a study of a few specific sociology experiments rather than a foundation class for understanding sociology. I did the readings, went to lectures and discussions- I did well, but I got very little out of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Mullins is one of the best professors I've ever had. I'm on my third class with him now. He picks amazing texts for the class to read- but you absolutely have to stay on top of the reading or you'll have no idea what's going on (a lot of reading!). His classes are always challenging and eyeopening in the best way possible. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: The topics covered in class were interesting but this class would've been a lot more interesting with a different professor. Mullins lectures like he's talking at a TED talk without any technology. No powerpoints or anything. He'll write some words on the blackboard at the beginning of class but no other visual aids so note taking was difficult.

I really loved his into to sociology class! The material was very relevant to the currant world and was interesting to learn about. The exams are not bad if you went to class and did the reading. They are take home and open note, so really nothing to stress about. There are few homework assignments that are straightforward. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's very boring. He teaches the class like it's a social theory class which is very frustrating. I love my TA and my discussion section though.
He is a great professor who makes class enjoyable
Lectures are jam-packed with information and sometimes I wish he would add a 5 minute break in the middle. Overall, and amazing professor though.

Iggy is a nice, friendly guy, but he has organized his class around lectures and lectures are not his strong suit. He does know what he's talking about but you're better off asking him in person than listening to him fly through 30 slides. Tends to wax romantic about Nobel prize winners who don't matter. His exams are hard.

Whoever commented below must be a graduate student or something. There was one person in the class who mastered the material like it was a piece of cake (100's on each exam). This class definitely requires attention and hard work for the average student. Great professor though. Completely willing to help you out. Exams were fair, but difficult.
One of the best professors at UVA. Really taught some neat things and very engaging. Exams were cake. This class didn't require a lot of work....
Friendly, approachable, clear, engaging. There's a lot of material and conceptual information to know and he explains it very well. One of my favorite professors in one of my favorite courses.

He is a nice guy but this is a hard class and he doesn't make it easier.  Its hard material and his test is picky.  Hes helpful though and will sit down with you and explain things.  Also he does make clear what he wants you to really know.  And that stuff you really have to inside and out

He Is not a good proffsor at all, for all of you who feel you don't understand him in the first classes just drop his class and don't waste time, he is not clear, his exmas are super hard, to be fair he has a nice character but if you wanna get good grade in his class you have to study neuro 24/7 if not you'll definetley fail his class!

Didn't like this class at all. I thought the lectures were disorganized and the tests super specific. Text sucked; better to read the alt texts where he gets his images. I recommend recording the lectures since he goes really fast through details. Take BIOL317 instead of PSYC220 before this class or you are at a disadvantage. Large grading curve.

This class was awesome.  Iggy is a great teacher, and makes sure everyone does well in the class.  Make sure to attend, as he throws random one question quizzes at you for attendance.  The material is great, and includes current topics that are interesting.

Iggy rules!  The exams are difficult, but fair.  The material is engaging and Iggy is a spectacular lecturer.  He is easy to get along with and easily accessible.  Take one of his classes if you like the material, it will be worthwhile.

Provencio is kind, caring, funny, and always willing to help a student understand.  His lectures were very clear, and his slides are very clear too.  Study hard for his test: I didn't really study all the details, skipped some class, and lightly skimmed some of the chapters and got a 58% (avg was 76).  The class was definitely worthwhile though! <3
I can't figure out why others do not like this man. He's smart, personable, kind. What more do you want?
Pretty hard but fair.  He should provide slides before lectures.
Conveyed difficult material in a clear concise manner.  He was enthusiatic in his teaching style.  Exam was difficult but fair.
Didn't outline the class well at all.  Unfair test.

Started out ok, but went downhill fast. Sucked all the life out of the material and lectured directly from his indecipherable slides. Tested the most ridiculus picky details. Class average for the first test was a D+. Over all, couldn't have been worse.

Professor Kuin was very kind and made the readings relate to our everyday lives.  There was a lot of group work but it's enjoyable because it's nice forming new connections and hearing other opinions.

Pros:
-She explains things well
-She's very nice and will go out of her way to attempt to compliment your translation even if it is wrong
-Office hours are great
-She holds extra help sessions
Cons:
-Participation is 15%, and she DOES NOT GIVE 100s. I had to convince her to give me a 97.
-She doesn't explain the composition assignments at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! She is very good at choosing relevant readings, and I really enjoyed discussions in her class. Tests and projects were always fair and useful. She takes student feedback well and is easy to ask for help. I highly recommend her office hours - she's great to talk to about classics or anything else.
I like his class. He is a nice guy.
He likes to drink. And is a good class
I like this class.
This is the first class I take in UVa and I really like this class.

This professor is a nice individual, but i think is very oblivious or acts in a state of oblivion. like for example some students were not given the platform to see if they have homework. She proceeds to take attendance on a date many students could not because of wifi issues.  Which is part of your grade. Many readings from books not in syllabus
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Sarah grades very hard.  She also has a huge work load of reading.  I believe that she is a very nice person and can be flexible with office hours but she takes a very long time to give feedback.

So sweet! Brought us snacks during exams and held Gothic movie screening nights. But reading load is too heavy. Sometimes assigned 100 pages to complete in 2 days. Class consists of 3 papers, weekly responses, 1 final, and participation. She grades pretty slowly but leniently. Papers and participation cushion your grade heavily though

Grading is kinda weird sometimes (I think it might just depend on her mood), and she takes forever and a day to get papers. There's a ton of reading and I think that a lot of it is pretty unnecessary. It was a seminar so I dunno if she was "supposed" to lecture, but she honestly didn't offer anything at all in addition to student discussioncomment

Sarah really cares about her students and is readily available to help you with your assignments (she holds many office hours and always answers her emails quickly). But she can be an unnecessarily hard grader, especially compared to other ENWR teachers. If you're looking for an easy A I wouldn't suggest her, but your writing will certainly improve

Sarah is very dedicated. You can tell that she comes prepared for class and is genuinely interested in the material she is teaching. She does a good job of explaining and tries really hard to make the class interesting. She's a pretty hard grader though.

Great professor who makes math actually enjoyable. allows corrections for homework and assessments.  genuinely cares about students and if you pay attention and do all the work you will succeed in this class
Very doable class. Put in the work and you will succeed. The material is very straightforward and easy to understand.

DO NOT, I REPEAT, DO NOT take Calculus with this professor. If you want to learn, pick another professor. If you want to fail and struggle in this class, with no help or guidance, be my guess. Promise he will not care, he does not collaborate with his students.

Terrible Professor, does not even know how to teach. If he is the only professor left to teach any Math at your school, might as well pick another degree. Doesn't teach at all, nor it seems like he wants to teach students. Professors are supposed to engage and help their students understand concepts, not this one. You need Khan academy all semester

Professor Bashkow has been my advisor since 1st yr and he is so helpful and kind. I am taking the major capstone class with him and he always gives out constructive and positive feedback. I struggled a lot to find a clear focus of my thesis and he was very patient in helping me find the right direction. He helped me a lot and I am very grateful.

The most difficult to listen to professor I've ever had. If you can't fall asleep at night just listen to one of Prof Bashkow's lectures - you'll be out like a light. Easy class but impossible to pay attention to which makes the final/final paper difficult to do. Seriously, nice guy, if anthropology is your thing go for it but if not, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Bashkow is such a delight. He is very passionate about what he teaches and really tries to understand his students and their interests. He typically keeps his classes very light hearted, but the materials and discussions in class are engaging enough that you still learn a lot. He is also incredibly accommodating and supportive of students
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is very passionate in what he teaches, showing us his work and how it relates to the topic of the class. He also values group work so we usually discuss things with our groups before talks with the whole class. The homework is requires effort but the class is so interesting that it's enjoyable.
He's a great teacher! Very enthusiastic in class and explains things well. Get to learn a lot about different cool topics. You will have to do a lot of writing in the class though.
An entertaining, intereseted teacher who will do everything to make sure his students understand

i dreaded this class because it was required for the ANTH major, but i love it, and i think it has a lot to do with bashkow. his lectures are interesting and funny, he makes very difficult concepts clear, and he doesn't give tests, just papers with a lot of feedback. i would definitly recommend his class. everyone in the class seems to feel the same way too.

He's a nice man, but he is a very stubborn professor. This class is still being developed, and so he's trying out different methods. Currently, the organization of the course is hopelessly confusing. But neither he nor the TA's will admit this and so you're on your own. Maybe it's better now...
One of the better PHYS professors at UVa
Professor Yoon was very enthusiastic during lectures and his midterms were relatively straightforward. Homework required TA assistance most of the time. Final exam was killer.
Yoon is not professional at all in class and in office hours. he didn't care about his students.

It is clear that Dr.Yoon was learning C/C++ together with us, but that's not what I want to complain. What he really needs to pay attention to is his communication skills with students. Whenever his mistakes were pointed out by students, he became mad and tried to hide his false.
He is mean and boring. His son appeared in class several times.
No Comments

Very very dull class and lecture style. Zero effort to conceptualize any aspect of the class in a larger economic framework, inexperienced feel to the classroom, and an overall "scroll through the slides" professor. Take anyone else.
Terrible professor

Intermediate Micro at UVA is going to be a hard class regardless of who you take it with. Professor Kripalani moves really fast during lecture, but she is super kind and was accessible outside of class. There's a ton of extra credit throughout the semester which you should definitely take advantage of. If you put in the work, you'll be fine.
Worst Professor I have ever had at the University of Virginia. Really disappointing.  Hard class regardless, but take with a better lecturer.

Professor Kripalani's exams are completely disconnected from the practice problems and lectures. Despite attending every class and studying extensively, her disorganized teaching and confusing test structure made it nearly impossible to succeed. A frustrating and disappointing experience overall.

She's a great teacher! This class takes a lot of work to do well, but every required project helps you learn more. Her and the TAs have office hours that are helpful to attend if you want a good grade, and going will help you improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love this course!!!! The works we've done seem not that related to architecture but in fact they do. Every project in this class help practice and improve the ways of thinking and the ability of aesthetic appreciation--fundamental skills that you need to become a qualified architect.

For a student not in the architecture school, Sanda is a phenomenal and engaging professor. She is truly compassionate towards her students. There is a ton of work which is why the class is hard, however, Sanda is very encouraging and will give you a good grade if you do everything and if you put in your best effort. Also a good TA is helpful.
I loved Professor Iliescu's personality, but as someone not majoring in architecture, I felt the work was rather extreme and I quickly became tired of the class as it was such intense work.

Took this as a requirement for architecture major. Difficult and pushed my boundaries. Very abstract. Be prepared for a project due every week. Be sure to get a good TA, they can make or break your experience (and your grade). GO TO OFFICE HOURS! She is only helpful if you ask for it. Recommended for majors and those interested in arch. Enjoy

Sanda is the best. More teachers ought to be like her. She is incredibly encouraging and truly cares about how her students develop. Although it isn't an easy A, it is possible, and the learning experience/growth from this class is tremendous.

Sanda is a fantastic professor, and really pushes for the students who show an effort or appreciation for the class. It is a good basics course for anyone who wants to learn design. Keep in mind that this course is a precursor to the workloads in studio, and should be taken seriously by anyone who is in the a-school or thinking of transferring in
She is FANTASTIC and made absolutely every lesson fun to attend. You almost didn't want to ever skip her class!!!!

GET A GOOD TA!  My TAs were so vapid and insipid that it made my head spin.  The class itself is wonderful, and would be even more so if the TA and discussion sections were moderated and kept the same!  I had friends who loved their TAs and made friends, while I just wanted to bash my TA's faces in.  Not hard to get a good grade, fun class.

this class requires a lot of work but definitely worths it. sanda encourages you to see beauty out of everything, making you start to appreciate small things in unexpected way. get a good ta (ask around) and you won't regret taking it.

get a good ta.  this cannot be emphasized enough.  the class gives good information and is wonderful if you want to learn.  i took it not as an A-skooler so i got to see things from an outsider's perspective.  question everything.  be wary.  Did i mention to get a good ta?  if your TA is not doing it for you, SWITCH.  Dont be afraid to switch.

This class is very demanding on time and energy, be prepared for many all nighters over the semester, of course the time you spend on projects you never notice passing by like you do when you are reading a text book for another class. And at the end there was this great rewarding feeling that made me want to transfer into the a-school.

This was probably the most challenging and ultimately most rewarding class I've taken. However, during the semester, it drove me crazy and most of the time I was just frustrated. There's a ton of work which requires late nights and getting friendly with your TAs.
No Comments

Very enthusiastic & passionate, but we were constantly assigned art projects that were fun, but I was left asking, "What about architecture?!" This class is great for kids who really wanted to be artists, but their parents told them to major in something that they could actually make a living at, hence Architecture. No help to me.
What an inspiring teacher!  She finds everything to be so interesting.  The class is a tough grade and it's a lot of work, but it's definately worth it in the end.
She is amazing, but it definately helps to get a good TA.  Don't be afriad to go up and talk to her during office hours, she'll love it.
a very eccentric lady who finds beauty in everything. loves to show student work in class. most work of any class i have taken, but fun. good for taking in a light semester.
sanda is eccentric, get a good TA: this makes all the difference

Sanda finds love in everything-brings great spirit to the lecture. Assingments are very open to interpretation-they can be time consuming but for the most part are pretty enjoyable. A good TA is a must!  Definitely recommend the class for those outside the A-school. Pick 102 over 101.
interesting
overall, i enjoyed the class, especially after 101. get a good ta

Sanda is a great teacher. After taking 101 this class really makes up for it. It definitely helps to have a cool TA for this class, because you could end up doing much more work than other sections. This is a great class for anyone interested in art/arch.

Prof. Manson is a great lecturer who is passionate about what she teaches, and she engages with her students during the lectures. She also provides lots of extra credit! The exams can be quite difficult, so don't cram your studying for them (like I have). Anyway, Prof. Manson deeply cares for her students, and I recommend going to her office hours.

Professor Manson is a great lecturer who is so, so passionate about what she teaches, and she provides lots of extra credit! Her exams can be quite difficult, so I suggest not to cram your studying (like I have) for them. Anyway, she also deeply cares for her students, and I definitely recommend going to her office hours, including the TAs.

Professor Manson is a great professor who is passionate about what she teaches and provides lots of extra credit, which I love! Her exams can be quite difficult and definitely don't cram your studying for her exams, but she does drop one of the exams depending which one you score the lowest (doesn't include the final). Awesome professor overall!

Dr. Manson is lovely. She is so knowledgeable and passionate teaching. Participation counts via pollev, lectures are very material-dense. Exams can be tricky; do the practice exams! Homework can be tedious.

She's very personable, and the lectures are interesting and engaging. The wording on exam questions can be a bit tricky, but it gets easier once you do the practice questions and get used to how she words things. Attendance isn't mandatory, but exams are mostly lecture content so it's in your best interest to go.
Excellent professor. Fair grading. Reasonable workload.

Expect to spend 10+ hours per week for exam prep for this class.

Go to P2L, rewatch the lectures. Easier than 2100 by far, but still have your work cut out for you

She offers close to 1.5% of extra credit

Lectures were cool but make sure you study what is on the powerpoint (beyond just what she says). Textbook is useless once you get to evolution, but crash course is great! Study the details to the extreme for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's nice but her tests were actually ridiculous. Every single question was her trying to trick you with wording. I could have recited everything from her slides and still received a C on the test.

Dr. Manson is a great person and professor, and she cares deeply about her students. I think many are upset because the material seems memorization/easy at first. Dr. Manson will test you on connecting and applying. So go to lecture and office hours, you'll do well, she will help you! Also she deserves more respect..

Professor Manson's lectures are engaging and she has many office hours for help outside class. Her exams can be difficult and questions are often very specific. However, all information is given in lecture. When taking exams, check every answer choice for something incorrect. She does genuinely want to help students.

professor manson is extremely nice and her lectures are pretty engaging but her tests are so convoluted and not super based on class material which is extremely frustrating for a student. I for one studied for her tests extremely hard and knew her lectures better than anything and still received C's on the exams due to the poor question selection.

Professor Manson seems nice, but she focuses many of her lectures on examples from her research and on things she is interested in. Her tests are very difficult, every question is trying to trip you up. I studied an immense amount for these exams and still felt unprepared. Read the textbook and go to lecture.

This class was nice because lectures had info on the slides, but you need to work to study for tests. There was a lot of weird wording that was confusing on exams that had to go back and be fixed. But if you can learn the lectures well you'll be fine.

Manson is kind of the worst. She has an obsession with plants and that's basically all you learn about. There are like a thousand vocabulary words you will need to know regarding plants and other things. Topics are super dense and impossible to remember. Tests are insane. Lectures put you to sleep unless you, like her, have a plant fetish.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, what she tests you on isn't explicitly what's in her lecture. Cool professor though.

Prof. Manson lectures like a storyteller, which connects the content of each lecture into an engaging, coherent takeaway. Her enthusiasm for biology is contagious. She cares about her students understanding the topic more than she values busy work or unnecessarily hard grades. 2200 was hard, but this upper level class is easy and fun!
Manson gives a pretty good lecture and puts words on her slides, which is appreciated. Never went to her office hours since I didn't think it would be worth it, but overall pretty decent professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took population ecology with her and loved it! It seems that people are kind of 50/50 about her when she's teaching intro bio, but I would definitely recommend her for upper level bio classes. When she's teaching about things she loves, she's super engaging and friendly and takes the time to make sure you understand tougher concepts.

Professor Manson is very bad professor who does not seem to care about the success of her students. Her lectures are unclear and she does not take the time to answer questions. I often read the textbook prior to class and prepared heavily for tests yet the questions were often confusing and unclear in how they were written.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I thought Prof. Manson was about on par with Kittlesen (the other intro bio professor) in terms of test difficulty but her lectures were easier to follow. This class is about as much based on memorization as it is on application, so Quizlet is your friend. If you keep up with the (admittedly heavy) readings the class is fairly straightforward.

Not the best prof. Record her lectures and take notes very carefully. Know everything she says in class in detail to the bare bone. I kid you not, there were questions on her exam that I thought she introduced in class "just for fun". Since the exams are filled with ambiguous questions, going to exam review afterwards can sometimes earn pts back.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. She genuinely cares that students do well; office hours are extremely helpful and she gives credit where credit is due. Not everybody likes the focus of her class, but it prepares you extremely well for upper-level courses. Test-heavy grades, but you learn so much.

Despite her haphazard passion for BIOL 2200, Manson fails at engaging students. Her class is extremely plant focused, speeding through the human anatomy, and swooning over her love for all plants. Nonetheless, her style and Canadian butchering of English words is bearable if you're a good test taker. Tests are 80%.

She is an amazing professor and is so excited when she teacher Biology. She is funny most of the time, and always makes the lectures interesting. She is a real gem. She is always available to talk and is the best Biology teacher I had here at UVA.

Professor Neeley is best described as an English major who gets her kicks from making engineers write. Please do not take her class if you like your GPA. She will act as if an assignment does not matter and then grade it as if it were your thesis. She is possibly the harshest grader with the largest ego and a lack of rubrics that I have ever met.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lots of unnecessary reading. Talks for half the class. Also makes you order and pick up a $20 physical reading packet from the corner, consisting of passages that she already has online PDFs of that she can easily share online; however, she is very traditional and prefers students reading and taking notes on physical paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She cold calls people in class, so youll have to make sure you read the night before. I may be biased as an engineering student, but the amount of reading assigned for classes is unnecessary, and it is difficult to receive over 90 on writing assignments ("solid submissions" count as an 88, "strong submissions" are 95(Hello?)).

For a professor teaching in the Engineering school, has very little understanding of any sort of technology. Uploads 40 page pdfs with pages all rotated differently, can't upload files to collab correctly, constantly has students explaining basic things like Google Drive to her. Frustrating to watch.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Neeley was the probably the single best course instructor I had during my time at U.Va.  She challenged me to think of engineering as more than just technical achievement without a social or ethical context. I am a better business professional thanks to her.
Neeley is very serious about the material and wants you to be into it. Jonas Hart was one of my favorite TAs ever. Just learn the main points of each reading and you should do fine.
Horrible class. Learned literally nothing from it and it can make you very frustrated because it seems to be the same no matter how hard you try.

Most boring class in history. Assignments are borderline idiotic, with prompts that let you know you have to BS to get it done. Readings are terrible. Lecture is disorganized. Professor seems to be rather stuck up. PhD in English, teaching a bunch of engineers random philosophy. Suffer through.

Says some interesting things sometimes, but other times you walk out of lecture irate that 75 minutes of your life has vanished.  The papers weren't too bad, but be prepared to make something up to meet the word count requirements.

Absolutely terrible class.  Every lecture is the same useless material and she acts like it is the most important thing that has ever happened to you.  She won't admit defeat and comes across as slightly arrogant.  Do not take STS if you don't have to.

So much reading. Thinks that engineers just think they work hard, and tries to tell us we don't.  Many useless readings.  Test is difficult even if you read the readings because multiple choice questions are basically opinions.  Suck up.
Worst ever.  Pompous attitude seething underneath endless discussions of the most trivial subjects you can think of.
HARD, but fair. Interesting discussions and topics.  I felt like I got the same grade no matter how hard I tried. Great teacher, but requires a lot of work and attention in class.

Addicted to the word 'notion' and will get it stuck in your head.  I also got the same grade for everything on a wide variety of effort.  She'll make you work like an english grad student but as for herself?..??  *Seems like a very nice lady but treat her like you're stone-hopping across a rapid river.  1 wrong step and you're shtlisted.

We do have other classes besides STS, and I have more work for this class than for any other class. Also, didn't tell us the date by which we had to read a huge book until the week before. Probably has killed 3 small forests from just the handouts she's given us so far this semester.

Very impartial in class discussions; gives you the same grade for everything. BONUS: cooked us yummy dinner at her huge house and we watched a movie for the class afterward.  It was very nice, she is also very considerate and nice

Thought she was great and selected her again for ENGR302. Then the nitemare started. She wrote me recomms for grad school apps which she later WithDrew W/O telling me b/c another prof badmouthed me to her, thereby causing irreparable damage to my future. she sure can smile but ruthless
No Comments

She'll make you read 300 pages per week, and she'll give you a terrible grade.  She plays favorites, and seems to give you the same grade on every assignment regardless of how hard you try.  Nice lady though, very hard, and bad grades. Boo
She's way too demanding.  I mean, we do have other courses that probably matter a whole lot more than TCC.  Nice lady and very into her work, but a Nazi behind the grading pen.

Prof. Neeley was my favorite teacher this last semester. She admits when the material is a little boring and does what she can to make it better.  Overall, the class was interesting and the work required really helped to learn the material.
No Comments
A great TCC instructor, makes class interesting and enjoyable. Approachable and cares about her students. Fair grader.

I got on a call with him as my dean and the connection didn't pull through, given my headphones experienced a momentary connection problem. This was maybe over three seconds. He kept saying hello in an increasingly angry tone, and though I apologized, he was extremely obtuse and obstinate, proceeding with an angry demeanor.
Worthless Dean. However, he is the perfect representation of the worst aspects of UVA so at least he has that going for him.

Did not take this class, but terrible Dean. Does not care about students, will not even meet with them in person. Is completely unhelpful with and impersonal when navigating specific or extenuating circumstance. Unsympathetic and does not even try to seem as though he cares.
Horrible Dean

Shawn Lyons is my associate Dean and he is an awful dean. He does not care for his students and does not help either. I asked about my classes and how to manage them as I am going through a hard time, and he said he cannot help. He is not understanding, blunt, and does not show any care for any individual. He says he is always busy and cannot help

Cool guyfun topic. Lectures could be a bit dry but has the occasional flurry of energy that kept me awake. If you do the readings and try on the papers and final, then it should be an easy class. Fulfills non-western requirement.
Very nice man, easy grader.

Easy, enjoyable class.  Professor Lyons is a beast among men.  He knows his material and can speak roughly 6 Euro-Asian languages.  There are two book/internet site/movie reviews and two tests, which consist of several short essays.  I definately recommend this class not just for its scholarly value, but also because of the chance to experience Sha
He possess the strength of 10 men and his only weakness is the small spot on the back of his heel where he was held while dipped in the river sticks.  Good easy class, knows his stuff.
He means well

Took Lisa for a my first ever J-Term.. she was amazing! So passionate and knowledgeable on the subject matter. Incredibly personable and a very kind soul. Never minded adjusting due dates if we needed it, always super flexible which helped a lot. As a result, I never felt super stressed at any point during the two weeks. Can't recommend her enough!

Lisa is one of the best professors out there. She wants students to understand the material, so many of her papers are reflective. She is extremely knowledgeable and passionate, and very approachable.

Lisa is one of the best professors in the WGS department. She is so funny but it's also clear that she holds vast knowledge and passion for her subject. She fosters fascinating discussion, treats her students as her equals, and requires very little work in order to do well. She just wants you to be present and provoked, and to respond.
One of the best professors I've ever had! Cares so much about what she's teaching and knows a ton. As long as you turn in the few easy essays and go to class you should get an A. No tests.

The best chem professor to take in the opinion of most. There's so many times I heard my friends with other chem professors complaining about things I never had to worry about. Tests have individual and group sections. A very reasonable professor, not too serious. The Tests are about 50% of overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very accommodating, super easy to ask questions, but class material requires focus and dedication to understand
Prof. Welch is great!

Kevin Welch himself is very caring, and takes the time to address students questions whenever they have them. However. His teaching style for CHEM 1410 did not agree with me in the slightest. His lectures are irrelevant to the tests and final exam, which means you have to teach yourself, and teach yourself almost everything. Great guy though.
He's really chill. Only need to go to expo, not lecture. Cheat sheet for tests and final. Nice guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I. Love. Welch. What a great guy. Lecture's aren't the most helpful but if you go to his office hours he will explain something over and over until you get it. Also the grade weighting of the course made it not that bad too. Chem is still hard but definitely doable with him and effort put in outside of class. I definitely recommend for chem 1
he is my dad
Decent intro chem lecturer.

You basically teach yourself everything. Lectures are literally pointless- I go just to say I went but I leave every lecture not knowing anything that was discussed. He will choose a random topic that was barely talked about in the textbook and focus on that all class which proves unbeneficial. Hes a very nice person just not great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is a great professor, very clear and is always available for questions and help.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Welch is awesome. He cares about his students and job. He's super lenient. Yes, there was an absurd amount of  HW but besides that, he'll extend assignments if you ask nicely, and he's overall a straight forward professor and doesn't overexplain things to the point where they don't make sense. He also hosts review sessions and posts note as guides

I really don't like Chemistry but Welch makes the class as easy and fair as possible and is a G as a person fr. His tests are online too and 70% of them are group work! There is a reason everyone loves him.

Welch did a great job at explaining the topics from the textbook in lectures and made it very worthwhile to attend class. The lectures are also all recorded and the grading in the class is very fair, where partial credit is given fairly often on the exams for missed answers
His Lectures were great, he made complex topics easy to understand. He is lenient and understanding concerning work and deadlines.

The class structure is unfortunate since the online textbook does not teach well and Professor Welch's lectures are often unrelated to the topic. Additionally, there is only 1 lecture a week and we have group exams. Welch does not answer emails and I'm still waiting for him to regrade Exam 1 from a few months ago. I do not recommend taking Welch.
super helpful at office hours, great lecturer, and really nice guy. overall, he slays

Professor Welch was a very kind and interesting professor. The way he structured class really helps the way you learn the material. he was very approachable if you have any questions. I would definitely choose him over the other professors! Highly Recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Welch is by far the best lecturer to have for chem 1410. The content is the same as all of the other professors, but his way of speaking and use of examples makes the class actually interesting, and a hard one to fall asleep in. Beyond being a great prof, hes also an incredibly nice person. 10/10 would take him if possible.

Avoid this class if you can. Welch seems like a nice, cool guy but he holds only 2.5 office hours per week which are usually completely full and his TAs don't hold any office hours. His lectures cover only the most basic material of the course, but the tests are extremely hard in comparison. It's very difficult to get any help in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Kevin Welch is always accessible outside of class and is also very very very accommodating of students and their needs. The tests were pretty straight forward with a few challenge problems if you study. With general chem being a known weed out class, I would highly recommend taking it with this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class online due to COVID-19 so the format of the class was different than most years. Professor Welch was always amazing at explaining concepts and was very open to questions. The tests were slightly difficult and require a reasonable amount of studying but it is reasonable. I definitely think he is the best chemistry professor here.
Cool dude. Bad lectures.

The layout of this class is constantly changing, so much of this feedback may not be that helpful for a future class. But Welch is a great professor to take into Chem with, he explains things much clearer than the other lecturers and has very funny and well planned lectures.

Welch comes up with the non-chem major orgo lab material but the TAs run the experiments. Concepts are pretty straightforward (especially relative to CHEM 2420) and if you're willing to go to office hours for postlab help the class isn't hard to do well in. Welch himself is very helpful in office hours and for the most part the TAs are too.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: My biggest complaint is how heavy his course relies on TopHat (online textbook). It often felt like I had to teach myself the material through these chapter readings. I also think expos (a discussion-type section of his course) were a waste of time. On a positive note, you can tell Welch is passionate about the material and cares for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Welch is pretty chill. His lectures are a little scattered or off topic on occasion, but the readings are really good and on topic for the exam. This class is a lot of work but also if you pay attention and don't get behind you can get a good grade pretty easily. If you're going to take intro chem, take it with Welch.

Welch comes up with the non-major orgo lab course material but the TAs actually run labs. Some TAs are better communicators and grade less harshly than others. Pretty reasonable workload for a 1-credit lab, and not having to code in Mathematica or write lab reports is a huge plus. Welch is super helpful in office hours and very easy to talk to.

Kevin Welch is an amazing person. He really cares about his students. While the class was very challenging for me, I still passed because of the hefty curve. (The short answer exams could be daunting.) He is really passionate about chemistry, and it shows in his lectures. I recommend this professor, but do not expect an easy A.

Welch is a great professor and easily the best intro chem professor at UVA but it's not easy by any means. His lectures are clear but you still need to read the textbook. His exams were quite difficult this semester but they were curved up to a 77% mean which saved many people this semester. Overall, difficult class but a good prof.

I heard lots of great things about Welch. I experienced none of them. His tests were unfair and difficult and the averages were failing. The TAs for the class are useless and his lectures did not clarify anything. Unfortunately, I do have to say that he is the best option for an Intro-Chem Professor

He's objectively the best Chem prof at UVA, however his tests can be bewilderingly difficult and confusing at times. He will curve, but it doesn't take away the fact that the exams are really quite awful for Chem 2.

Show up to class and pay attention to his lecture. You don't have to read the textbook. Welch is nice and a lot of people think that he's super chill. Not an easy A but not hard overall. Definitely one of the better intro Chem professor at UVa. There is usually a waitlist to get into his class but don't panic most people will eventually get in.

Straightforward class. Test questions are like the homework questions, so do the weekly homework and make sure you understand it and you'll be fine. I definitely recommend reading the chapters to fully understand what's going on -- chem isn't easy, but Welch is chill and doesn't try to trip you up. Put in the effort and you should succeed.
I love this man. He genuinely cares about his students and does his best to make sure everyone understands the material. Also adds some humor into his lectures which makes the class more enjoyable.

Dr Welch was a standard intro chem professor, except his dad humor made waking up early more bearable. The course included online hw on Sapling Learning, which was weekly problem sets. I recommend buying textbook access through there too. Reading quizzes on Collab. We had iclicker questions every day. He had a lot of office hours, as did his TAs.

Good teacher take it with him. He gave out a lot of extra point in 1410. Test are fair but he do occasionally throw in about 3 tricky question each exam.  Your lowest exam score is only worth 6 percent. I mad because he didnt round my 92.8 to a A because the class average was a 85 percent.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Welch is a great professor. It is important to do the readings before lecture, otherwise lecture doesn't make sense and you're lost. He's very helpful in office hours. He didn't have practice tests this semester, which would've been nice, but moving forward he may. He made chemistry seem light, because of his humor. But chemistry is still hard.

Professor Welch is honestly amazing! He explains topics so well and on top of that he's so funny I love his personality. He always uploads his PowerPoints onto Collab which is helpful when studying for tests. There is a decent amount of reading he assigns but it honestly helps for when he reinforces the concepts during lecture. So glad I had him.

Welch is an excellent lecturer and won't put you to sleep. Power points and written out problem answers from class are always posted online. He has clicker questions in class (not graded by accuracy) that go toward a participation grade. Weekly problem sets are not as difficult as those used by the other chem professors.
Welch definitely seems knowledgeable about the subjects, and his tests and grading policies are very fair.

Welch is an excellent lecturer and teacher.  He is very good at explaining difficult concepts.  There isn't much homework aside from reading the textbook and weekly problems sets.  From what I've heard, Welch is the best intro chem teacher at UVA.  He posts all of his lecture slides online so it is easy to get any information missed during class.

UIUC: His lectures are good. I really appreciate the interactive feel that they have. He doesn't try to overcomplicate many things that might be new to his students. And even if he does, it's not like it isn't something that you can't overcome. The tests are not too bad in this class, but the MPs can be horrendous sometimes. Overall, not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: UIUC CS340 Review: This professor awesome. He truly cares about each student, which is rare considering the class size was ginormous. The lectures where all spectacular. He is legitimately on par with the likes of David Malan in terms of making you *feel* excited to come to lecture and learn CS. UIUC is lucky to have the likes of Luther.

Amazing professor, very knowledgable. He really cares about students' wellbeing, he even personally emailed me to check on my progress which honestly says a lot. He knows the topic is difficult, but truly wants you to understand the material and enjoy it before determining your grades. The way his class is structured is ideal for an online course.

One of the best professors I've had at UVA in terms of his ability to keep you captivated. CSO is not an interesting topic but somehow he manages to keep you paying attention. He's a bit of a character but in the best way possible. You can tell he's a very smart professor and is genuinely interest in what he's lecturing.

Grading: Tests (40%), Homework (40%), Lab (20%), Weekly Quizzes (20%)

A very tough course. The lectures are great, but sometimes it doesn't have to do with the content in the quiz or exam. Failed the last test. Homework Assignments are HARD AF!

Bit fiddling, Assembly (I hate the bomb hw), and schat (asks you to make a chatroom in C Programming)

Prof. Tychonievich is absolutely fantastic! He really tries to explain everything as clearly as possible and provide plenty of resources for everybody to learn the material. He was very patient and always willing to try to explain a concept in another way to help someone who was confused.

Fantastic. Favorite, most enriching class Ive taken so far. Apparent that Tychonievich put a great deal of thought and effort into the assignments in such a way that gives students a great understanding of the course material. Never has a class been so exciting and rewarding.

Professor Tychonievich is a wonderful discrete math instructor! I went in not knowing even what discrete was and now he's made the topic fun! He teaches with pen and paper rather than computer, however it's still a great course! Quizzes almost every friday, however for a 20 minute quiz, you get a 30 minute review. Take this if you can.
One of my favorite professors. Even though his lectures are recorded, everyone still shows up because he is a great lecturer. His projects are hard, but the class feels great!

So he's not a bad guy, but I hate the way he teaches. The material in Computer Architecture is hard enough. He doesn't have to try and make the class more difficult than it needs to be. His constant quizzes are an annoyance and the labs have literally never helped me learn anything. In fact, I found that they confused me more than I was before.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I found this intro class to be very easy, and L. Tychonievich was very helpful in keeping the class fun, interesting, inspirational, and educational.  He was great at teaching the class, gave good feedback, solved problems with ease, and was excellent in interacting with the class.

Tychonievich is such a character, I'm really going to miss him.  I took CS 1110 without any prior knowledge of coding and enjoyed it alot.  If you dont have prior experience, find someone (preferably in your lab) who really understands and can study with you.  Make sure you go to TA office hours early because the wait time can be very long.

Tychonievich takes the time to respond to anonymous feedback and explain misunderstood concepts.  However, his lectures have little structure and come with little visual aid.  His test questions are long and ambiguous and there have been multiple times when his own answers have been wrong or ambiguous as well. The book prepares you more than him.

So if you have coding experience he is great for CS 1110, however if you know jack about coding take 1112. The class can be a lot of work and it will suck if you get behind on POTDs. I would recommend this class if you want to be a CS major because its fun and you get to code cool stuff, lots of software design. Don't take 1110 if you don't like CS

Definitely not an intro level class. I had zero coding experience coming into this class and it left me struggling big time. Large amounts of assignments that take hours of work, and tests that are very unlike the assignments. The book is what teaches you the most. The guy is sarcastic, teaches way too fast, and doesn't directly answer questions
