Teacher was nice and helpful though somewhat unorganized, ansd often he wouldn't plan out class time well.  Not hard to do well if you like literature.  I didn't have a particular interest in the subject matter but i still found the class interesting.

While he is generally accessible for help when needed, Professor Murphy's exams and homework assignments are really difficult and he typically fails to prepare students. His study guides usually cover a fraction of the questions on exams.

Very understanding professor; rounded my grade up. The course is pretty easy, just listen to astronomy researchers present. However, the homework could be quite advanced if it regarded coding or advanced math, especially because there are astronomy nonmajors. All assignments are graded out of 5, so do well on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He dropped me an ENTIRE letter grade for being late to ONE class and after I provided him with a valid excuse, he only brought my grade back up by 3 points. I showed up to class 15 minutes early after that, and my grade never got back up to where it was. I would not recommend this professor to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am not a STEM major, but I definitely enjoyed this class. It was more difficult than I anticipated as I ended with a B+. The exams were pretty difficult, but take home so that was nice. The class is quite lecture heavy and I think you do need to spend some time outside of class preparing if you want to do well on the exams. Lots of homework.
Really loved this guy and this class. Highly recommend for the science credit.

This class is a lot more work than you think. There are many homework assignments that range in difficulty and Labs are a big part of your grade. The lectures are super important to doing well on exams since the slides do not provide a lot of information. The tests are open note and online so take detailed notes.

Great professor's lectures felt long, but occasional jokes were made. Most labs can be done later, but it's better to do them before finals. I skipped most lectures to watch them online, but PollEverywhere, a participation grade worth 10% of the final, is crucial. Midterms are long and the final is over 100 questions. Homework and labs are easy.

I LOVED THIS CLASS. I took mission to Mars as a first year (I'm a drama major). I have an A in the class right now. One of the most passionate professors ever. I never get tired of his lectures. We watch cool rocket videos, Neil Armstrong vids, and homework is online, lectures are recorded, and exams online and open note.
The best teacher ever

Murphy was a great professor and I really enjoyed ASTRO 1210!!! It was not too difficult and I felt like I learned a lot. He is obviously very passionate about the topic which led to an engaging lecture. I liked how the class was set up and it is evident he wants you to succeed. I definitely recommend this class to future students.

Murphy eats, sleeps and breathes astronomy and expects you to do the same. If you took this bc you're "not a math and science" person, and need to fulfill an easy requirement, this is not the class for you. Extremely lecture heavy and a ridiculous amount of information to learn. Thank god for participation/homework, bc tests and quizzes are hard.

Prof. Murphy is a really nice guy and good lecturer. He loves the subject. This class is way more difficult than I expected because the quizzes are very specific and challenging. The homework is pretty easy however, and he offers in class questions as a way to bump up your grade. Pretty easy to get a B, but challenging to get an A.

Fantastic course! I took ASTR1210 and ASTR3450 with him, and he was great both times! 3450 Mission to Mars is writing heavy, so beware of that going in, but it's a really fun course. Murphy is a great lecturer. He loves the topics and gets really invested, and if you have him online he has really cute cats. 10/10 would recommend.

I took Mission to Mars the 1st semester it was offered. Murphy is a pretty good lecturer & his lectures were pretty engaging. The homeworks were very simple a&easy, same for the tests. Unfortunately, however, this course didn't have much Mars-related content and was more just about space travel in general. Mars was only really looked at in detail

Dr. Murphy is a must-take. While the class is a challenge, and you will have to put the time in to understand the concepts, you will be better for it. He is inspirational and a fantastic source of advice and information.

Professor Murphy is a great teacher who makes sure that you learn a lot without the lectures being too overbearingly boring. Be warned, though: the quizzes can err a little bit on the difficult side, so make sure that you take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Murphy is an amazing professor. He enjoys what he does, and makes the material interesting. I have absolutely no complaints about him. However, the class is harder than it should be. The quizzes are pretty difficult and almost impossible to study for. Getting a B is pretty easy, but the quizzes are brutal.
He is awesome and makes the lectures super cool!
Such a nice guy and very passionate about the subject, if you need a science credit and you're a conscience major I would 100% this class with Murphy. Very interesting and I had no previous knowledge

I took astronomy because I wanted an easier science course than biology or chemistry.  Its not too bad if you read the textbook and attend lectures however the quizzes are very tough.  Ask for help and go to office hours if you need to. He is very helpful and better in one-on-one teaching scenario than a 400 person lecture.

He's extremely knowledgeable and passionate about his subject.  The lectures are fantastic, even for non-Astronomy majors.  He's extremely helpful, and has tremendous clarity in lectures.  His quizzes tend to be hard, but taking the class is definitely worth it; it's been a very eye-opening experience.

If you want to take a class with someone who is very passionate about their field, ASTR 1210 with Edward Murphy is the one to take. Wonderful, engaging lectures, and interesting material, I'm very glad to have taken this class. There is weekly homework that goes along with the readings. The exams are challenging, but not bad if you study well.
Professor Murphy is clear and straightforward giving lectures with a good sense of humor. I'm actually doing an astronomy minor inspired by his enthusiasm for astronomy and teaching

Mr. Murphy is great! If you want to learn about Astronomy, learn it form him. He is clear, entertaining, and fair. Assignments are helpful towards studying for the tests and as long as you went to lecture and read the textbooks the tests are not too bad!

Lectures are good at explaining things, but if you want to do well you need to read and take notes on the chapters, which are long.  The stuff you learn in general is pretty interesting (even though the book is dry), but don't take this class as a GPA booster.  If you put in the work you can get an A, but you can't just show up and do well.

He wastes time in lecture going on about astronomical events he found exciting rather than covering important material. Also, he makes most of his quizzes based on material covered the exact class before the quiz instead of quizzing students on the material leading up to the lecture right before the quiz.

I highly recommend Professor Murphy.  He is very approachable and helpful.  I struggled in this course and he was always willing to take extra time to explain and review concepts with me.  His lectures are very interesting and he strives to make sure his students understand the material.

Murphy's "quizzes" are very challenging. If you're looking for an easy A or an easy math/science requirement, this is not it, although you do pick up some interesting astronomy tidbits along the way. Put in the work by reading the chapters, and you will probably do well. Test questions often come right from Mastering Astronomy.

This class isn't too bad, but I didn't particularly like the class size. Murphy is a really enthusiastic teacher. I didn't know astro was actually going to be so much work. The tests are actually pretty hard, but if you're super excited about astro, then take it with Murphy.

Murphy is a great guy and is extremely passionate about astronomy, however this is not an easy class by any means. I took it thinking that it would help my GPA, but it's actually lowering it. If you are interested in the subject and willing to put in the effort, take this. However, you need to try very hard to do well on the tests.

Murphy is a really nice guy and is adorably dweeby about astronomy, but the actual material is really boring. The online quizzes help a lot when studying for tests, but this class is not an easy A -- you have to put in a lot of work to do well.

You have to study to do well and you have to know the textbook very well. There are probably 3-4 relatively easy math questions on each test, if you understand the equations. Other questions come from the "Study Area" from Mastering Astronomy. Murphy is a cool teacher and really knowledgable. Just study! (I expect to receive an A/A- in the course)

Don't be deceived, you will not be learning about aliens. This class is not difficult, and is kind of interesting. The tests are from material in the book and a few online readings. If you like astronomy, this is a good class.

This class is not as interesting as it sounds - be careful!!! It's not difficult, but it's quite boring. Murphy isn't unpleasant - actually seems like a pretty nice guy! If astro is your thing, go for it.
Dont take this class, its like a vocab class with astronomy terms

Lectures are long and cover lots of interesting material. It's hard to take notes because he goes through slides quickly. Online homework is most helpful when studying for quizzes, which are 40-50 multiple choice questions. Final is in same format, but longer. Murphy is smart, but this class was a bit more math/physics than I anticipated.

He's a great teacher, I came into the class with a pretty good interest in Astronomy and am now looking at becoming an Astrophysics major.  Tests are tricky but it is because there are parts that are actually application instead of regurgitation.
Murphy's a great teacher! He's really passionate about what he teaches and the class is pretty interesting.

Prof Murphy is engaging and helpful.  He had us work on our presentational skills while teaching us about a really interesting subject.  He will now be by academic advisor for my stay at UVA.  I highly recommend taking a COLA by him if he offers again

Murphy is a cool guy. He knows what he's talking about and covers everything you need to know in lectures. I stopped reading the chapters because as long as you pay attention in class, you will do well on the quizzes. On quizzes he expects you to be able to apply the material, not just know the facts. Kind of boring, but not very hard.

Class seems very easy during the first couple weeks, then you take your first quiz and you realize that you made a mistake signing up for ASTR 1210. Do not take this class. The quizzes are ridiculous (much harder and more in depth than lecture/homework) and lecture is painful to sit through. Don't take this

Probably one of the best Professors I have had at UVA. I Originally took the class because I needed science credits. However I now am very interested in astronomy and wish I had taken more classes as an undergrad.

If you are not naturally apt in Math/Sci, avoid this class at all costs. He makes the material seem a lot easier than it does on the quizzes. The class average for the three quizzes was always in the D-C range(around 109/150).

Great class! Murphy is a very enthusiastic teacher who really cares about this subject. His 121 and 124 classes are pretty easy (if you attend class) and are very worthwhile.  The tests require studying but if you go to class you won't have to study much. Definitely take this class if you are at all interested in astronomy.

Great professor, makes the lectures very interesting and you can tell he really cares about his students.  He would send out emails to the class letting us know of interesting astronomical events.  Because he's very enthusiastic about his subject, it makes the class very enjoyable.  It's not that hard either.

He's amazing! Don't take astronomy unless you can get him! His tests are pretty hard, but nothing you can't get through and they do take the whole 50 (plus some). Do the labs early because weather can be awful! You do use your textbook some for the online homework but not much.
You need to study a whole lot for his tests. 50 minutes isn't enough to fully complete his test.
He is awesome!
This guy's name is Eddie Murphy.  He's also a very good teacher, his explanations are easily understood and he repeats everything that's important.  Very enthusiastic too

Lectures are good because he demonstrates everything and repeats things for emphasis. He'll also keep you updated on space news. His tests may seem harder than lecture, but its only because they are not fact regurgitations. Study applications of the stuff you learn, and you will be fine!

Mr. Murphy is a decent teacher.  However he doesn't do well in presenting the material in the way that he tests you.  The lectures are mostly easy to understand and then the test comes and everything is much more complicated than any lecture made it out to seem.  By the end of the semester, I dreaded going to this class.

Do not waste your money on the book, you will not crack it once. Murphy is a nice guy with a good sense of humor. Probably need some general interest in astronomy to enjoy his class though; he can make the concepts interesting but can't make you care. Not an easy A, but study for the tests and do the labs early and it's attainable.
Decent teacher but could work on delivery of material

This guy rocks! period. You can definitely tell how much he cares about his students and how he wants them to learn. Once, I couldn't study for an exam because of a rehearsal I had had the night before; I explained everything to him and he let me take it on another day. Tests are ok, you only have to pay attention to the class and you'll do fine.
great class!  fun and interesting.  Prof Murphy is awesome.
Murphy makes astronomy interesting. It's a great class but the tests are more difficult than I expected. Go to class because the book is a waste of time and money.

A truly great professor that is extremely passionate about the subject and teaching.  Going to class and just paying attention is easier than reading the book, as he is very easy to follow and posts his slides online.  Tests were more challenging than I expected, but not terrible: just make sure you really understand the broad concepts.

Professor Murphy was extremely helpful and cared about his students, legit. He brought in some neon tubes one day. He doesn't overuse the laser pointer.  His tests are pretty hard.  Don't bother reading the textbook, just study the slides.  You have to go to class towards the end of the semester as his slides turn into all pictures.  Other than tha

Murphy is fair, fun, and extremely helpful.  Go to class; he makes it as interesting as possible and it will be worth your while when it's test time.  Probably the best Astronomy professor you can get.
very very good.  really enjoyed the class, very clear, tests were clear and comprehensible.  but study!  it may seem basic but can be detailed.  i greatly enjoyed this class.
interesting class, fair professor, fair grading

Excellent lecturer and his class was really interesting, but don't underestimate the difficulty an astronomy class can have. His quizzes were really difficult b/c it combined different things that you learned from the class. Highly recommend taking him but make sure you study your stuff.  (3 quizes, 1 final)
Ed Murphy absolutely rocks. He is the coolest man of all time. HIGHLY recommended- you will learn so much from him. Great guy.
Murphy is my favorite professor!  knowledgable, funny, interesting, passionate about the subject!  Don't bother reading (tests are straight from lectures).  I loved this class!

Great professor with a lot of knowledge and passion for astronomy. Class is more conceptual than mathematical, which can be good depending on what kind of learner you are. Only bad thing is he posts old, irrelevant lectures online, so you really have to go class and take notes. If you attend most of the time you'll be fine.

Best teacher for astronomy, lectures are clear and contain everything needed for the test.  You don't need to buy the textbook for this class.  The class is a little more math based than you might expect.  Overall the class is interesting and you will enjoy Murphey's passion for the subject.

An interesting class. In retrospect, I shouldn't have picked this class (as a non-science person) just for an "easy" class to fulfill my math/sci requirement. tests were not easy. You can tell Murphy knows what he's talking about and he's really interested in what he teaches.
this class sucked hardcore. it was really boring & I studied my butt off and did terribly. I'm definitely in the minority though. just beware this class isn't a gut for EVERYONE. murphy was mediocre.

Go to class and stay awake, which is hard but gets easier, and you'll be fine.  Tests all from lecture notes.  Probably will NOT do well if u don't go to class and instead read textbook and online slides.
he was fine, i wasn't interested in the course, but some of his lectures were really cool. the quizzes aren't anything to worry about and the other grades help out.

as a non-science person i thought these tests were really hard but it was still worth taking this course to finish my math/science requirement.  as far as i can tell, he's the best astron. professor...he actually makes this stuff bareable
The class is really boring but Murphy's very passionate about it so that helps some. If you need to fill a science requirement, definitely take it.

Murphy is a good lecturer - very clear powerpoints with all the info you need spelled out. Tests right off the lectures and classroom excercises - study those. Very enthusiastic about his subject and involved in cutting-edge research.

Prof Murphy is wonderful! He's funny and really wants you to do well in his class. He tries hard to make the subject interesting and relevant and goes out of his way to be helpful. The tests can be a little tricky, but not bad. Highly recommended!
Basically all you have to do is go to class, stay awake during lecture, and briefly review the slides and classroom exercises for tests.  Reading textbook not necessary so long as u go to class.

Extremely knowledgable, good lecturer and interesting material. Pay attention to discussions and review slides online and the class is no problem. I like the updates on current astronomical findings, makes everything more relevant to today. Very nice guy, really tall like everyone says.

He is very enthusiastic about the course and presents the material in a clear manner.  The tests are mildly difficult, but if you attend class and do the classroom exercises it's good.  I am definitely taking his ASTR121 course next semester.

I really enjoyed Murphy's class. He does talk fast; pay attention in class and it's not bad. The quizzes were more difficult than I expected, but not totally ridiculous; sometimes it seems the multiple choice are worth too much. Wants to see his students do well and offers extra credit if needed

Murphy rules. There are alot of freebie points, but the tests (atleast the last two) are not total pushovers. Subject is very interesting and Murphy is enthusiastic. Don't let the fact that is a giant or that he has power of this mysterious "DARK ENERGY" scare you away.
Overall good.  Gives many chances for easy points, provided you just do the activities.  Approachable, interesting lectures.
he is a good teacher.  lectures can be a bit dry sometimes.  first quiz is easy, but the next two are harder.
Class is harder than I expected going into it
Extremely knowledgeable, good lecturer, good humor, and his class is not difficult and quite enjoyable.  Recommended.

Mr. Murphy is the MAN. His lecture slides are online.  His quizzes are not bad if you pay attention in class.  Makes class interesting.  He is so freaking tall. He wants his students to do well. Explains things clearly.  Even gives extra credit if the class in general is not doing so well.

Cares a lot about his students and does a great job presenting the material clearly.  One of the two best professors I had in 6+ years of college.  A pretty easy grade as long as you read/go to class.  Also, he's 700 feet tall.
Great Job!  Really knows his information and is able to relate it well to those of us who are not rocket scientists!
very nice man who tries really hard and obviously cares a lot about his students. perhaps not the most stimulating class but a good choice for humanities majors looking to fulfill requirements.

He is a nice guy and makes an effort to help, but I thought his teaching style was mediocre.  His lecture slides have lots of irrelevant material that makes it confusing when reviewing them, and he talks way too fast to take notes.
Very good professor that teaches a very clear and interesting class.
you're my boy ed
Ed's the man.

Tests entirely from the lectures, and mostly the classroom exercises. Classroom exercises not only help keep you awake, but the tests are partially taken from them. Very clear lectures and not that hard of a class as long as you actually go.

Really dedicated teacher.  Definately harder tests than Tolbert, but likely a better teacher who is very engaging and truly cares about his students.  He encouraged students to write reviews of him online.

Emery expects you to remember every single word he says in class, every single word in the textbook, every and single word in the scientific journals (about 10 per week). If you're on the verge of a mental episode and need a straw to break the camels back, this class is perfect for you!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: loved him!
Such an interesting course and Emery is clearly passionate about what he is teaching. There are extra credit opportunities available and although it is a lot of textbook reading it's not unmanageable

Robert Emery is fantastic! He clearly cares about his students and he is very approachable. His lectures are very engaging, but they do deviate from the textbook content so you need to both pay attention in lecture and do the readings in order to be well-prepared for the exams. He offers extra credit opportunities in the form of easy papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Emery is my favorite prof I've had at UVA. The lectures are interesting, the tests are pretty easy, and there are extra credit opportunities to improve an entire letter grade. I highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. He was an arrogant man, and makes you read the textbook that he wrote. His tests were formatted to trick you, and your grade is based solely on those 4 tests. He was a dry lecturer and it was a challenge to stay awake. I read every chapter and still struggled to pass - DO NOT take abnormal psych with him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: great professor.
Shes so nice and really wants to listen to what you have to say!! I went to her office a few times and she was always so welcoming!

This isn't Professor Ogden's usual domain, but to my understanding, she is a good instructor. I think the class would have benefitted from an in-person option, but as it stands, her EGMT 1510 course was very easy, as are pretty much all Engagements courses. If you don't know what to take for EGMT 1510, this is a decent option.

I took "Meaning and Saying" in 2020 Fall. Ogden was caring/generous enough to allow students to grade themselves basically. Everyone got an A. But Emily is so special for other reasons. She's extremely present, gives students 1-on-1 attention. She's funny/kind. Her lectures rock! She wrote heartfelt notes w/ each grade she gives that are amazing.

Great Professor. One of the most thoughtful and truly caring people I've ever met, and a very intelligent, insightful professor to boot. She cares about her students on a personal and academic level, and she helped me out a lot.  She has high expectations for her students, so your grade on your first paper may be rough, but it gets easier.

Professor Ogden has been my favorite at UVA. She is a great lecturer, but allows for plenty of discussion. The reading comes out to about 300 pages a week, but novels go faster than articles and are much more fun. She expects a lot with assignments, but praise from her means a lot and that really pushes me to improve. Great class, amazing teacher.

Professor Ogden is one of the greatest teachers I've ever had. She is patient and kind and incredibly intelligent. She leaves a generous section of class time for discussion and is open to everyone's ideas. She teaches you how to close read. One paper, two passage identification exams, a lot of talking. One of the best classes I've taken at UVA.

She had the best transition during the quarantine period out of all my professors. She is extremely accommodating and very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject she teaches. It really resonated with me. I have learned so much about writing in the course of a few months.

Emily is the best teacher I have had so far! She cares deeply about her students and the material she teaches. She is interesting, smart, and funny, and provides very helpful feedback. Emily is an all-around wonderful teacher and person, and I would highly recommend her to anyone.
Emily is AMAZING. She is really passionate about what she teaches. She made a mandatory writing class a pleasure to be a part of. I was able to become a better writer with her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Emily has been one of the best professors I've had thus far. She cares so deeply about her students and this empathy translates well into the classroom. Emily always encourages her students to do their very best. I truly learned a lot from her class, and I can easily say she made me into a better writer. Take her classes if you get the chance!

Emily is the most influential educator I have known. Her class was insightful, introspective, and explorative. The poetic tale that she weaved was entirely original and riveting; its not just Whitman and Eliot, but a collection of unique voices that all have something important to say about the human condition. Whatever she is teaching, take it.

I had never taken a creative writing class before nor had I ever written poetry, but none of that mattered when it came to this class because Ms. Lawson is such a great professor. She truly cares about all her students, she loves the material, and you can tell that she really enjoys teaching. I loved this class.
Amazing class! Lawson encourages creativity but not at the expense of insight. She introduces you to poetry in a really unique way--you won't be reading a who's who of the Poets Hall of Fame!

The world needs more teachers like Emily! She is incredibly thoughtful, considerate, and open minded. She really worked to understand each student as an individual and created a warm, collaborative, welcoming classroom environment.

I have taken Spanish courses before, and I can attest this was the worst experience I have had in a Spanish course. I feel she was trying to cover her own insecurities as a professor by being unnecessarily tough and unapproachable, believing her own hype. I usually enjoy studying hard and learning Spanish, but she makes it a painful experience.

She is not willing to do anything to help students. She knows the Spanish department is popular and pretty much flaunts it in your face and when you ask her for help, the best she will offer is, I'm sorry I can't do anything when she can as department chair. A good professor should care for students and do all they can to help.

Emily is really sweet and passionate about teaching linguistics! The material isn't exactly fun - it's pretty hard, with a ton of memorization - but I thought it was very interesting and learned a lot about the background, development and sounds of Spanish. A few pop quizzes but the exams are pretty clear. No surprises there. Very cute!
To be honest, she was just mean. I bet shes nice when not on the job, but this class overall was just a waste of time and a pain. I would rather eat leeches.

Only take this class if it is an absolute requirement for you to graduate; it's usually not. Emily is very knowledgeable but extremely boring, the class is too hard for no reason, she makes the already boring material more boring, we go through a lot of material very quickly and learn nothing in the end. Avoid this class at all costs!
While Practi****is not necessarily the world's most exciting class, it would be 20 times worse without Prof. Scida.  She's wonderful to work with and really cares about all of us in her class.

Emily is extremely willing to help us improve as teachers, and she really takes an interest in our careers and wants us to succeed. Ok, so the readings and work aren't the most interesting things in the world to us. It's not her fault!
She's really good at what she does.I would strongly recommend her, even though this is one of the hardest spanish classes I've taken, its very interesting.

She is a great professor.  Really good to work with, willing to talk with you if anything is wrong.  She can tell when you are bsing so those who don't like her is probably because they didn't put an effort into the class...

As much as everyone likes to attack Scida on her teaching abilities, no one stopped to think that maybe its the course.  She does what she can with this course because, really, how can you teach teaching?  She is fair and does not deserve to be crucified to such a rude and obnoxious degree.

In my experience in talking to friends studying languages at other institutions, the mandatory pedagogy class is universally reviled and hated, along with the professor (who is usually in charge of coordinating language classes at the lower levels).  Emily is a nice person and a great teacher - very clear and helpful - once you get past her venee

Let's face it: Emily should have absolutely NOTHING to do with future generations of teachers...she's spiteful and vindictive, in addition to playing favorites inside and outside the class. Some of her liberal, feel-good methodological claims are nonsense and she has no clue how to substantiate them when pressed. AVOID EMILY!

You would be better served to punch out your teeth and chew foil with your bleeding gums than to spend a minute in her class.  She has managed to subject innocents to an intellectual failure of biblical proportions.
This class is horrible!! Do anything you can to get out of it.  It´s a big phat waste of time, nothing but busy work, not helpful at all.
No Comments
Tim is the best Calc2 instructor ever. Unfortunately, he's leaving here...'cause he's got the PhD!! Tim is so awesome!! I'm really sad that he's not gonna teach Calc3...
Great teacher. Funny and helpful. Extremely patient with students.

Tim is a really good professor and will help you with whatever you need help with. Class gets harder as the semester goes on so it's almost necessary to go to his office hours. Yet, if you just go and make sure to do the work, you'll be fine. Very fun professor, uses awesome words like sweet, groovy, and fun examples.

Tim is the NICEST guy you'll meet in the math department. He will go over things 500 times without getting impatient at all. If you go to office hours and do the homework, you'll be fine on the quizzes and tests. Him and his wife baked cookies on the day of our exam. Take his class!

Tim rules.  He's really into what he's teaching, and really wants his students to be into it too, so he's super clear and tries to crack jokes which go over well sometimes.  "OH okay" "BAAAD" and "Groovy" pop up in my notes quite a bit.  Go to office hours, seriously.  And he's pretty hot for a nerd..I'm always like "Just keep teaching me math!!"

Tim is by far the best calc teacher you could have in the 120's series of calc. The written homework is the hardest part of the course. The thing I don't like is that he didnt curve like other calc teachers. But its because everyone does well on the exams. You learn a lot compared to other sections. And go to office hours, he; really helpful.
Tim is a really nice guy! He gets a little flustered sometimes, but he is always willing to help and answers questions well. Webassign and written homework are easy and help boost grades!
I'm definitely taking Tim for calc 2. Everyone in the class loves him! Tim's the man!

You don't need any prior experience in math for applied calc 1. People ask the stupidest questions! The exams are somewhat more difficult but partial credit is given. The written homework was the harder but it's not assigned that often. Quizes on Wed. and he loves to make you define terms. You'll hear "Oh OK" and "BAD!" often.
No Comments
Great Teacher and a good class. Makes it very interesting and if you need help he has great advice and can be very helpful.
Good teacher, you will pass tests if you just study the slides from class.

How do I love Howie? Let me count the ways...He's an engaging lecturer with a great sense of humor and a lot of knowledge to share. He tells you the first day that you don't need to buy the book unless you want to, holds fantastic review sessions and gives fair (but not easy) tests. I loved this class.

I was not happy with the way he taught- everyone else claims he was clear, but I found him to ramble on and on about graphs and skip very quickly over information that would be found important- and proved to be important- on his exams. I know I'm not the only one who felt this in the class.

Great class, great teacher, great atmosphere!  I loved 320.  You must study and go to class to do well (duh) but you learn so much more than other Environmental Science classes taught at UVA.  Epstein makes himself readily available and his enthusiasm helps make the class fun. Not the easiest EVSC 320 class (Smith is) but it is REALLY worth it!

The class is hard, but Epstein presents the material clearly and is very available at office hours. It's a requirement for evsc majors- so don't take it just for credits. Overall, I learned a lot and I'm glad I took the class.

Fantastic.  Lectures are well-organized, he posts powerpoints online.  Very helpful and more than informed on his material. Plus he's a nice guy with a good sense of humor and cares about his students.  Usually two tests and a final-  YOU MUST STUDY -but they are very fair and he has review sessions.  Attendance is a must to do well. Very worth it.
Very knowledgeable about ecology.  Lectures were very well presented and easy to understand.  Also had a good sense of humor which made the class entertaining. Also helpful and easy to get a hold of.
Really listens to the students, and makes material very clear.  Very good tests.

I thought this class was going to be informative and fun- please don't take this unless you are planning on majoring in psychology!! It was useless and a massive GPA tanker. I am in the engineering school and taking very difficult classes, yet this was my lowest grade. Emery was no help, and the fact that your entire grade was only 4 tests was crap
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Emery is engaging and approachable and makes you care about the material through interesting vignettes from his clinical practice. You do have to be interested in children to care about this class though: it's not an easy A and you won't do well if you skip class. Tests have essay questions but don't get discouraged! It's a fun class! :)

Easily one of my favorite courses. The tests aren't too difficult if you attend lecture and pay attention. I can't say enough glowing things about Emery.  He's a brilliant professor, and his lectures are absolutely fascinating.

He makes the class much more boring then necessary. Textbook is exactly like the lecture but has just enough information that you also have to read it. The class is structured around DSM-5 rather than around the actual disorders. Wouldn't suggest it.
Can be a hard class if you don't know how to study so don't take it as light workload....its pretty hard..EMERY is awesome tho, by far best professor at UVA!!!! also really interesting lectures
Very interesting lecturer, and genuinely cares about his students. Super interesting subject material, but lots of long journals to read.

He is a great professor. His anecdotes were fascinating and a his description of his cases were amazing. I was disapointed when I had to miss a class because I really enjoyed lectures. This is saying a lot considering it was at 9:30 in the morning. Take the class. You won't be disapointed!
He's a caring and enthusiastic professor who thinks of his students as his children. He also offers to be of assistance for any non-acedemic problems you may have.
First time he was taught this class although he WROTE the book.  Lectures were not engaging.
His lectures were just so interesting
Fun lectures.

I got an A+ in this class, the best grade I've ever gotten in college.  This was also the only class I have ever truly not attended.  The few times I did go, I really enjoyed his lectures and thought he was very interesting.  The extra credit is easy and helps a ton!

He is a little backwards. Not open to new interpretations. Often found offense in his lectures (as a female), and found lectures to be dry and slow. He thinks he's funny. He's a little too sure of himself, could use a little humility. He obviously doesn't have all of the answers (though he thinks he does).

lectures are a joke & BORING! went to the first 3 lectures & stopped. he elaborates too much on some topics & not enough on others. i got an A reading the bold words of the book & the ch summaries. exams ?s straight from the book. final is easy. all exams weighted the same. extra credit.
Interesting lectures, easy tests, extra credit - if you're taking Psych 101, take it with Emery.  Your GPA will thank you.

lectures are interesting and useful for the test. if you have time to read, you'll do well. fun projects for extra credit, but otherwise no papers to write or anthing like that. final is worth the same as other tests.

Easy A (maybe A+ if you do the extra credit). Everything you need to know is in the book or slides, lectures were a waste of my time! He's an OKAY professor...don't think he really prepares before class though because sometimes he doesn't even know what's on his slides.
His personal stories made the subject matter come alive.  Really cool guy :)
great lecturere, interesting class
great professor, very entertaining class.
Interesting class...wonderful professor
No Comments
He's wonderful, and a great teacher.  I will be signing up for his other classes
he's great!!!
One of my favorite classes, by a really entertaining teacher.

Loved this guy! He was a great professor and truly cared and wanted you to succeed in his class if you showed him you wanted to do well. Lectures can sometimes be a little long but really not that bad. Mini quizzes, final group project, and an open note final exam for my class. I highly suggest this class!
Professor Martin is THE BEST! He truly cares about his students and really feels invested in all of our futures. He is a truly special professor.

Professor Martin is awesome! He really cares about his students and is so knowledgable about consulting and other business fields. He is a very fascinating lecturer and always brings in great guest speakers.

What you will gain from this class: 
1) Business Mindset (how to become an entrepreneur in action)
2) Business Notions (a lot of useful tools such as business model canvas, value propositions, etc.)
3) Connections and Experience (they invite many guest speakers)

What you won't learn from this class:
1) How to start a company
2) Legal Issues

There was a LOT of reading for this class (EGMT 1520 -- From Language to Data), but ultimately, I learned a lot! This class is probably not for everyone, but as someone who finds artificial intelligence with respect to language very interesting, it was really interesting to see how relevant this topic was.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Fredner is one of the best professors at UVA. His class was very easy yet the class that I learned the most in last semester. I highly respect him and he is definitely a students first teacher.

Erik is genuinely the best professor I have ever had. Very well-spoken and kind. I took American Satire with him, and I learned so much fun, valuable information from him. There's definitely a good bit of work/readings but if you do it on time and put in an effort, you'll get an A. The content was SO interesting, and he just made learning so fun.

I took Fredner for American Satire and overall had a good experience. The overall workload depended on how much you did the readings. You really learn as much as the effort you want to put in. Contract grading is a free A, and makes everything essentially for completion. He's a nice guy, and this is a solid engagements option.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Very informative. The online course has a lot of lectures and there are several papers due, so don't think you're going to just blow through the class to get an elective, but everything was very interesting and Professor Harrington stays very engaged with the class. I didn't expect to enjoy the course nearly as much as I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Almost done with ART 121A at ODU and I HAD to come on here and leave the best rating. Professor Harrington sends frequent reminders about each assignment and when it's due which is so helpful. The course itself is fun and makes you want to learn. Easy online course with multiple assignments due each week but they aren't hard to do. 10/10

I am only halfway through the course of Art History 120 at ODU. Professor Harrington is one of the best teachers I have had throughout my college career. He is on point in his lectures, makes his discussion threads, quizzes and tests challenging but trust me, you will be engaged and eager to learn more. The content is interesting. A fun class.

Uptight and with odd rules such as requiring the purchase of physical texts instead of ebooks despite having absolutely no stated and or logical reason as texts were only ever read outside of class time. Lectures were not suitable to notetaking and felt almost pointless to attend.
My favorite professor at UVA.  Really knows the material and is always happy to help!

Linstrum is really a great professor. I love going to lecture and, although I could have skipped many times, I never wanted to. He gave lecture outlines at the begging of every class that really helped me structure my notes. Only two papers, neither are very long or difficult. The TA was very good at helping to understand things. 10/10 would take!

Linstrum is a young guy who's very active and happy to be teaching. He gives out helpful course outlines and makes expectations clear. The readings are very long, but you can get by without reading every detail. For someone teaching about the British Empire, he really doesn't seem to like Britain, and teaches with an agenda, but I got by that soon.

One of my top 3 professors at UVa.   Linstrum is relatively new to UVa but that just means he gives his students that  much more individual attention. If you try in this class and go to office hours, you can get an B+/A. Absolutely adore him. His knowledge of the British Empire is impressive and he's so passionate.
Great course! Professor Linstrum is very approachable and really encourages you to participate.
unbelievably boring. would never recommend this class to anyone. she sucks. just reads off slides. tests are hard too.

Definitely not an easy A. There are few tests, and they are extremely difficult. However, she does curve so that the class average is an 85, which is super generous. Lectures aren't recorded, and tests are mostly based on powerpoints, so definitely go in person! One on one, she's very kind and knowledgeable.

Horn is a very nice lady, but the class is hard. Your entire grade is 3 exams + the final and the exams are extremely detailed. Questions are on the smallest, seemingly unimportant facts/topics from class. She also offers 6 extra credit papers, and if you pass them all your grade is boosted. The ECs are VERY difficult and have unclear expectations.

This class is famously difficult, but if you love psychology or just mental health in general, you might just be okay. This class is what a lot of people think psychology is all about, and while that's not entirely true, the material is very important and I recommend all PSYC majors take it. Credit to Prof. Horn though, because she made it work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Horns tests are primarily based on her powerpoint slides and not so much the textbook. Her tests were pretty hard and timing was tricky, but she curved pretty well which is always nice. I highly recommend doing the extra credit assignment! It might seem like a lot of work, which it is, but it can really save your grade since it bumps it up.

I loved the course and Dr. Horn is a very intelligent person. Her tests are a little tricky but she curves them (in everyone's favor) and so they end up being fair. She provides all you need to know to do well on exams, but her lectures can sometimes be monotonous. There is extra cred, its tough to get but definitely worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Horn is a decent lecturer, albeit somewhat boring/monotonous. Her lectures are extremely dense with information, and you can tell she's slightly anxious while giving lectures. Her exams are very tricky, with at least 5/6 questions each exam being ambiguous and poorly asked. She is very nice and helpful outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class with Prof. Etem. The lectures are so boring and often irrelevant. The projects and papers are interesting, but the directions are vague and confusing; you basically can write about whatever you want. An unnecessary amount of homework that I never did, and still got an A. I wish this class focused more on analyzing films
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Prof Etem's MDST 3338 (New Cinema Histories) and had a great experience. Lots of essay assignments but if you follow instructions they're easy to score highly on. Final paper lets you research a topic of your choice. If you're a strong writer with any interest in film, this is an easy A. She's extremely caring and always willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor is too politically correct. Reading powerpoint all the time, with so many discussions posts and 40 times 120 words ins account big project at the end of the term. TOO MUCH WORK to do. Run, if you really want to learn anything.

TOO. MUCH. BUSY WORK. Julide is constantly giving students movies to watch and pointless articles to read, and they don't contribute anything to the class or the lectures. The class is very easy and it would be hard to fail, but I feel like she gives the busy work to make up for her lack of skill.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Jülide is a phenomenal Italian teacher. When I'm early for class and overhear the stuff another class is doing, I feel so privileged to not have any other teacher. Jülide only speaks in Italian, which makes it difficult sometimes. But she prepares you more than you could even imagine. I'd take this class ten times over!
Asked professor for guidance ahead of an exam and he insulted me. Does not want students to succeed.
Eugene is cute and the lecture is pretty organized and clear. The only defect is that he murmurs to himself 80% of the time. He is helpful during office hour though.
Awful. Didn't curve grades, even smart kids got horrible grades. Doesn't explain anything. Just avoid any class that he teaches, even though he is brilliant.

He has good intentions, but he's not very good at teaching such a large class.  He was a day or so behind the homework that was due, so I had to read ahead to get my work done.  Does lots of example problems, but doesn't really explain much of the physics behind how he solves them.  Only reason I showed up for lectures was to get clicker credit.

Well intentioned, but difficult to understand.  Will just do example problems the entire class, but you have to come because there are clicker questons.  Nice at office hours, but will not just give you answers.  Interestng/fun demos.

Advocate of the learn-on-your-own/discovery style of teaching. Lectures are interesting, but are not as in-depth as the homework requires. As below, the things he teaches cannot be found in any one (or even a dozen) textbooks. Exams are not too difficult but not enough time is given. Class average is about 50%.

Has no interest in helping students.  I asked for some clarity on the notes and he said that I should just read the copy in the library which are useless.  His lectures are confusing and he does not explain concepts.  Things he teaches are not found in any textbook.

The class lectures were not similar to the homework problems or the test problems at all.  The homework problems were ten times easier than the test.  Getting a good grade in this class was practically impossible and it would have been if it wasnt for the curve... (if you got 50% on the test, it was an A)
Kolomeisky is so cute. And he cares about all of his students. He is really a great guy.
Professor Kolomeisky is so cute! He really wants all of his students to do well, but his class is pretty dificult.

It's not so much the professor but that class that's pointless. Yes, the professor has an accent, but his lectures are useless when it comes to the homework. Also, one of the tests was comprised of solely symbolic problems, just like the lectures, and EVERYONE failed.
Difficult to understand his accent.  Just like 142, there is no point to go to class.  The test material comes out of the homework and the lectures are painfully boring.
Very strict. You need to be on time because she deducts your grade by the minute. Penalizes you for the smallest thing.

I took 5 years of Spanish in highschool, but I learned significantly more in this class. In-class time is focused on grammar/vocab. The online homework gets tedious, but it's incredibly helpful for learning. She's friendly, helpful, and gives great feedback. Tests are fairly easy and not much studying is required if you do the homework thoroughly.

The class is conducted totally in spanish, but she is very understanding and patient with you if you don't quite understand what is going on. The class is pretty easy, but to get an A you have to have 97% which seems impossible.

pros: friendly, good teaching style, and engaging material
cons: unhelpful and borderline hostile via email, inconsistent grading among students and will be unresponsive when called out for it

I had her for Business Spanish, and she really is an amazing person, but the workload for the class is kind of crazy. You always have to be on top of things because deadlines are almost always back-to-back. This class consists of a lot of projects and group work, but she is always there to help and if you like business, then def take the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lot of hw. Pretty easy A-. It's really tough to get an A

She gives a lot of unnecessary homework and makes everyone do blog posts for every reading through Collab. This class is more about culture than it is about grammar. When we do grammar, though, it's very easy. I would have liked to take this class with a different professor. She a very nice person, but my Spanish didn't improve.

POVEDA IS AMAZING. She is engaging and helpful, really eager to help her students but also wants them to learn how to write better and how to understand deeper topics (biculturalism, identity, immigration) better. Her use of vosotros is a bit off-putting at first but it's not difficult to get used to.
She is very helpful and always available during office hours. The work load isn't too bad but you learn a lot about culture, and you become a better writer. The themes were interesting as well.

Sometimes confusing when explaining criteria for assignments but always happy to make herself available if you need help. She's a pretty lenient grader. Lectures are sometimes boring but she's very open to suggestion about what you want to learnimprove upon and will structure her lectures around your feedback. Had her twice, would take her again!
Really encourages students to participate. She's patient with students who struggle and holds lots of office hours.

This professor is amazing! She is really nice and respectful, I feel comfortable participating in class and I am sure everybody else feels the same. She makes the class entertaining and interesting so it is easy to be engaged. I strongly recommend her.
She just seems to really love watching everyone learn!!

Her exams do not reflect what is taught in lecture. I got an 85 for participation when I attended every discussion, actively participated, and cited the readings in my talking points. In order to get an A for participation you need to show "grad level" skills. Eve is a horrible teacher and the TAs were even worse. Do not take this class.

She is a good lecturer and the materials taught in this course were really easy, but her tests were tricky and worded in ways that can have multiple interpretations. Also, though attendance isn't mandatory, still go to lectures. Many of the test questions are based on what she says in it and she does "pop up" attendances sometimes

Prof. Danziger is an interesting professor.
For an intro class, do not take this. For higher level classes, I'm sure she's much better.

She specified that "graduate-level" discussions and thoughts were required to get above a 95 in your participation grade. Graduate-level thoughts...in a 1010 class. Make that make sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very few grades, so everything counts a lot. It's basically two classes in one- Mayan culture and Intro to Linguistics. She's interesting and entertaining, but sometimes the material is dry. Sections (with TA) are interesting though. Test questions can be unclear, although she say's they're in the reading, but I'm not sure about that. Eh it's ok :/
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had 2 classes with Prof. Danziger and they were informative, well structured with moderate amount of reading material. Always available to students with questions and has reasonable expectations. UPenn educated, she caters to those who want to learn. If u think its unfair to be graded on attendence or her lectures r boring-UVA is not for u then.

Professor Danziger is a brilliant individual who changed my life. If you're not interested in the challenge of learning, though, she probably won't be for you. If you want to think more deeply about the nature of mind, language, and humanity, you should definitely take a class with her.

I would only recommend this class if you have a genuine interest in linguistics.  I liked the class overall and Professor Danzinger seemed involved and interested in her field, though some of the test questions were unclear.  The research project was pretty fun, though, even if it too was a bit unclear.

Lectures were vague about what was important; didn't go into enough detail. Tests are multiple choice w/ some short answer. Final was easy. Majority of grade depends on HWs, which were tedious to do and often had unclear instructions. TA was great and more helpful than the class. Would not take a class taught by her again.
Prof. Danziger is one of the most brilliant individuals I've ever come across in my life.

She's pretty much just boring. She's midly excited about her topic, which is helpful, but the excitement is far from infectious. If I attempted to explain anything I learned in her class, I don't think I could do it. Also, I saw her at an Anth conference sleeping in the front row. Real cool.
So boring.  I hated going to class, which was unfortunate, as she graded on attendance.

Best teacher ever!  Asks subtle but brilliant questions that lead you to new insights.  If you like to be challenged to think in new ways, don't pass up the opportunity to take a course from Danziger!

The class isn't too hard. Not a lot of work. The grading is unclear so it's difficult to see how you can improve. The TA didn't seem to know much. Dr. Danzinger seems to control all aspects of the class.  Interesting. Somewhat slow paced.
not too hard, but kind of boring - only three exams and a project - not the clearest grader on tests but that may be the TA's fault

Had Pivonka for PLAP 3400 and it ended up being my favorite class of the semester. As long as you do the readings (no textbook, all online) and participate in class discussions you should be good. 2 essays and 2 tests but they weren't bad at all. Pivonka is really animated in class, genuinely wants to hear students' opinion, overall cares a lot.
Evan is fantastic, it's extremely straight forward and easy course. Much better than my intro to American Politics course. Even if you are not a polisci major I recommend taking this course.
LOVE HIM

Definitely my favorite class of the semester TAKE THIS CLASS. The class becomes a great discussion every time, and if you do the readings, it becomes a lot of fun. Evan may be young, but he really knows his stuff, cares about you and your grade, and works hard to make sure you get as much out of the class as possible.
My favorite class ive ever taken!
Laid back, but very arrogant.  In my opinion, he's overrated.
If hes the TA for any class youre taking, take his section. Hes hilarious, and a geniunely good TA. He knows his stuff, and youll have a great time.
Great guy, he makes discussion fun and engaging and will always try and reach out when you need help.  It is impossible too feel bad during his discussion sections
Cool guy, knows his stuff too. Not always on topic, but a fun TA.
Kevin is the last true professor.
Kevin is a great artist and inspiring teacher. Extremely dedicated to his students and to "art makin'" in general. A wonderful mentor and friend.
No Comments
Eye-opening, profound, insanely intelligent, and inspiring.  Classes aren't structured too well, but it gives the artists in the class the freedom to create.

He's pretty intense and swears more than any human alive. But if you can get past that, then you will learn SO much about filmmaking - 16mm, baby. He supports his students 100% (will go to your plays, events, concerts, etc.) and will do anything it takes to help us make that art! KevEv is the MAN.
Kev is the man.  What an original.  You will have way too much fun in this class and make some cool art in the process.

Kevin Everson (kev*), is WONDERFUL. Learn how to make films using cool old cameras; take this class! Recently, short listed for an oscar in short experimental film, the man has talent.  Plus, he's utterly devoted to his students--even takes them to NYC!

I would avoid taking ENWR with "professor" Keeling.  Very unprofessional, and his comments on papers often show that he barely skims over your work.  You better make a good first impression as he pretty much decides your final grade in the class after the first few weeks.  With that said, you can do little to no work and get a B or B+.

Very down to earth professor. Passionate about what he teaches. The class is pretty easy but definitely go to his office hours if you need help with your writing assignments. Had four papers in total which was not too bad.
PhD in philosophy, enough said.
The class is a little boring. But some of the stuff he taught was useful. And he lets you turn in your papers as many times as you need before you really have to turn it in.

Fairly lengthy projects but the majority of grade is from one exam (or two normally, but he cancelled our first one due to an error in the syllabus). Also doesn't have a clear grading scale (uses stars and colors to grade). He is fairly lenient with grading, which makes up for the lectures that don't make much sense. No clear objective.

Professor Evans was definitely my favorite professor this semester. It's very clear that he puts in the time to make lectures interesting and I found myself excited to come to every lecture, which is surprising and impressive given the content of the course. Definitely recommend taking a class from him at some point. Was accessible outside of class
The best professor I ever had. He basically designed a class that included the most interesting things about the entire CS curriculum.

The class should be easy if you study with a group. He might be good at teaching CS, but he is terrible at teaching math. He consistently misuses definitions and gives handwavey solutions and proofs. If you ask him questions in office hours, he sometimes gives you the wrong answer, so beware. Easy pass, but don't expect to learn rigorous math.
Great class on Udacity

Worst professor I have taken in 3 years at this university. His operating systems class uses an in development language called Rust with a buggy compiler and no real world application. His assignments deal with web servers and shells and emphasize learning this language rather than operating systems.
Very clear. He ROCKS!
best one
He Rocks!
HE ROCKS.

Took Udacity CS101 with Prof. Evans without previous knowledge. Not easy,but he's a guy who loves to make people learn and empower them, also knows what he's doing and how to get it across. Looking forward to other courses with him!
Very good Prof. It's amazing how he teachs.

Professor Evans expects a lot from his students and often gives us very challenging problems. Sometimes I feel that he is too smart to know that someone might not understand what he is talking about. Despite that, he is very knowledgeable about the subject matter. I learned a great deal from his class and it was also fun to work on the projects.

Worst class I've ever taken. EVER. If you can avoid him, do that. Sitting through lecture is like being tortured. And he's just such an awkward person to be around. He might know what he's talking about, but he certainly isn't very good at explaining himself.

Professor Evans knows just about any question you can ask him. The class is challenging for everyone, it's not as hard for people who have had programming before but still isn't easy.  Class is taught for people with no prior CS experience.  Tough course but is definitely possible to get an A if you put in the time and effort.

I took 3 classes with Dave. He is really the best teacher in the world because he really cares about his students.  I am forever grateful for how much he has changed my college life.  Take his class.  I know it seems like you are going to fail and get an F, but trust me, it will be all right.

Freaking awesome.  Took a hard subject and made it interesting and fun.  Homework assignments can be gruelingly difficult at times, but he and his TAs hold plenty of office hours.  Well-written tests - if you know what you're doing, you'll be fine, but if you don't, you'll get your butt kicked.  Gives lots of extra credit.

I really enjoyed his CS 150 class, which he created and wrote the textbook for.  If anyone is remotely interested in computer science, I would recommend this class - there isn't too much programming because the focus is on computer science as a whole.  Exams and assignments can be challenging, but are open-book.
He really tries to make you learn, and I'm sure he would be fascinating if I was interested in the subject.  All tests were take home.
Best teacher in the department. And brilliant.
Excellent professor, challenges his students to rise to the problems he assigns.  The "star based" grading scale motivated me more than any grade ever could.
Very nice and helpful person, but his homework assignments tend to be difficult and time-consuming.
Class contains lots of interesting tidbits. The stuff I did understand I thought was cool to know. The stuff I didn't understand, I wish I could.
Really Great Professor!

An odd guy, but seemingly friendly. In the class I took he didn't assign letter grades, instead gave out colored stickers (you got a gold star!  good job!). He's easy, very easy by e-school standards (only A I got there). Very much on the theoretical side of computer science, which was a nice change

Arguably best prof. in engineering school. Very nice, helpful, and truly wants you to learn. He cares more about effort than performance. If you suck at CS, take this class and try your best even if you can't get it right, he'll give you an A.
so far the best cs professor at uva.  class is not easy, but he is willing to help you and grades lean towards the amount of effort you put in.  very nice and friendly.

This is the best professor I have taken at UVA. Challenging material and you will work a lot but interesting and worthwhile. Just read his teaching philosophy which he epitomizes: http://www.cs.virginia.edu/~evans/teaching.html
Great teacher. Really wants you to do well. Most interesting CS class I've taken at UVa.
fun class, you'll learn a lot.  pretty fast paced, but lots of hlep is available.  prof is friendly, wnats you to do well
Great class! I learned a lot! Tests are very fair, makes you think! Problem sets are hard -- you have to start early, but he is ALWAYS willing to help!
He's incredibly nice. And incredibly attractive.
i loved this class. best english class i've ever taken.
No Comments
Two words: BOMB DIGGITY.  Evan rocks.  You're lucky if you get him.
Excellent, committed, fair.
HOT!!!
Exum is awesome. She's really nice and pretty. She teaches well and even makes funny jokes. SPAN 201 is so easy with her. I highly recommend her.
Impressive, enlightening, and occasionally entertaining. Learned a ton. Would like to take a course with this Prof again.

This is possibly one of the worst classes I have ever taken at UVa. His lectures rambled on and were full of useless tangents. On top of that the lectures were never useful for essays or tests. The class is very long and a complete waste of time. The teacher is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate but assumes his students know more than they do.
Great class. lectures are awesome, massively informative, peppered with pictures. just a bit too early in the morning. TA is really quite good too.

This was a wonderful class. I learned so much about modern India. He has a great knowledge as he has been there over 1 year. I would fully recommend this class and hope that he would have a tenured position.

This class was worthless. His lectures tended to ramble, and he almost always ran out of things to say. it was really frustrating because I'm really interested in modern India, and I don't feel like a really learned a lot; his lectures were truly terrible, the reading assignments uninspired, the essays graded oddly.

I really enjoyed this class! I don't know what the last comment was talking about. Not only did Prof. Rashkow have a lot of great insights into India's history, and cover a lot of interesting material in a clear way, I know this was his first time ever lecturing on the subject which is really impressive!

I really enjoyed this class! I don't know what the last comment was talking about. Not only did Prof. Rashkow have a lot of great insights into India's history, and cover a lot of interesting material in a clear way, I know this was his first time ever lecturing on the subject which is really impressive!

I honestly think this is the worst professor at UVA. Not only were the lectures painful to listen to (uhh, umm, excuse me...) I had no idea what he was talking about half the time even when I did the reading. He is extremely awkward and unorganized. I regret ever signing up for this course. Stay as far away from him and his classes as possible.

Despite the professor's interest in the subject matter, I found the class frustrating at times.  Lectures could be difficult to follow and I found the reading to be arduous.  My main frustration with the class was that it seemed like more work than the other 1501 classes I've heard about.

I had Ezra for a Postcolonial Theory class. He was extremely passionate about the subject matter and he grades pretty easily. However, there is a good amount of reading and it seems like he never actually gets what he is thinking out. So class can be a little stressful. Other than that, he's my favorite, and tries to make post-colonialism fun.

First class felt I'd jumped in the middle, of the course. The vocabulary that he uses, you really need to know the subject matter before hand to understand. Also he makes you keep a vocab book, and take a quiz on the words and make 5-10 speeches on the reading at the beginning of one of the classes, which is complicated.
Amazing teacher! Very enthusiastic and friendly. 10/10 Would recommend

Jason knows his stuff, but he can be awkward. His grading is pretty fair and if you are absent but for a good reason he is pretty nice about letting you make-up work. Overall a pretty fair grader, sometimes his discussions were a bit boring and he seemed distracted at times.
He is a bit pompous, but very knowledgeable about history.

She clearly has favorites in the class. We broke into groups to look over projects and she called out "stronger" students and had "weaker" students pair with them. She then (in front of me) hugged my partner and without looking at her essay, said "Oh she is so amazing, Im planning to give her an A+ in the class because she is such a joy to teach".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was a real commitment, but extremely rewarding. Papers are a core part of your grade, but there are rewrites and other make-up opportunities. The actual material is not *hard*, but to really enjoy it you do need to get involved. STEM major here, loved this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: I was really looking forward to this class. Farooqi made it unbearable. Being South Asian, she picks on you for knowing a little more about the subject than non-South Asians. Not only that, she humiliated a girl in class for not being a stereotypical South Asian. She thinks she is clever, but really just mean and an ineffective professor.

Like you potential student pondering whether to take a class that knocks out two pre reqs like Dracula, I too was excited for this course. Nonetheless, Farooqi is a terrible professor who basically taught the class on a whim, was not available outside of class, and left the grading quite ambiguous. DO NOT TAKE!!!
It is a shame to have professors like Farooqi in UVA. UVA is supposed to be a good school with good professors but it is very unfortunate to have professors like Mehr Farooqi are 10 yeared at UVA!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She was by far the worst teacher I had at UVA. Her childishly mean and needs to be reminded that he doesn't rule the world. She's probably a great teacher if he doesn't decide to treat you like scum.
This class is horrible!! Do anything you can to get out of it. Its a big phat waste of time, nothing but busy work, not helpful at all.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Most horrible professor I have ever had in my life. Very lazy, demanding, disrespecting ,.... I would never take a class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Farooqi is  hilarious, a sweetheart, and a bit of a badass. She made lectures really fun but isn't afraid to call you out if you did poorly on an assignment or didn't do assignments; she means well, so don't take it personally. She's a bit scatterbrained, but her lectures were always interesting and fun. Definitely recommend the class!

Professor Farooqi in nature is the nicest woman ever. Humorous, kind, passionate, caring, and intelligent. She honestly is like a mother away from home. She puts in 150% percent, and genuinely cares about the well being of her students. Honestly, she is amazing. I highly recommend this class to anyone who wants to experience the beauty of UVA.
Professor Farooqi is so supportive. People try to hard to get in her classes because she keeps them speaking and energized. I still look forward to taking more classes with her.
Excellent.

Prof. Farooqi is just a sweet person who has a great interest in the subject.  She's really helpful and nice, and she's a very easy grader - it's an easy A as long as you read the novels(which by the way are extremely interesting) and make sure to participate twice per class.  the journals & the final paper are also extremely easily graded!

Seems to be just an idiot at the beginning of the class, but she begins to grow on you. Get her to talk about herself and you'll appreciate the class more. Readings range from semi interesting to awful, but she's willing to work with you and adjust assignments.  I didn't get that much out of the class, but it wasn't awful and the workload is light.
No Comments
No Comments
Terrible professor, would not take her for engagements

Professor Milani was an amazing teacher. I learned a lot about different culture issues and real world problems that were often overlooked by the media. Overall she was a great professor who had very engaging and thought out lectures with brilliant guest.
nice person but too harsh a grader for a 2 credit engagement course
Milani is a nice lady in the appearance, however her classes are really boring. We basically talked about the same subject over and over at her class.

I took a class with her for the second time and I highly regret it. Milani doesnt like for anyone to disagree with what she thinks. She also Isnt a fair grader. Her grades highly depends on how much she likes you.
Mialni finds her own ideas brilliant and doesn't like for any student to disagree with what she thinks. She also assigned many books for purchase which were never used in the class.

THE GREATEST PROFESSOR IN THE LAND!! but seriously-- this class was incredible. milani has a lot of interdisciplinary expertise to bring to classes aside from being literally the top of her field in forough farrokhzad. count on profound insights and interesting observations from her every class. easily one of the top 3 classes i've taken at UVa.

She is inspiring, intelligent, classy, clear assignments, interesting readings, and she would do anything to help anyone. She is a true scholar and it really shows. She was definitely meant for teaching. I never met someone who didn't like her or enjoy her class.

I had Prof. Milani as part of Semester at Sea. What an inspiration! Everyone absolutely loved her and her classes. I am so lucky to have gotten to know her. Even if you aren't in women's studies... you MUST take a class with her!
She is incredibly intelligent, helpful, and caring.  She let's you redo any paper or test if you don't like your grade.  Take a class with her before you graduate

Professor Milani is my favorite teacher at UVA.  Aside from being the smartest person I know she is so welcoming and willing to help.  You can write anything over againuntil you actually like the grade.  Take anything with her
Milani is amazing.  My favorite professor at UVA, by far.  An amazing class that truly changed the way I thought.
Professor Milani is wonderful and she is extremely intelligent. If you are blessed with the opportunity to take her class, take it!! Very nice grader, too!!!

There are not words to express my distaste for how she teaches and treats her students. The most important thing to her is herself, not her students. I wish I had never taken any course with her and would never have taken this course if I had known what she was like.
Maybe the worst professor I have had at my time at UVA. Really makes you wonder how she was hired. Please avoid any class taught by her if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awful experience in this course with this professor. She does not seem to really care about the success of her students and is overall difficult to interact with. I had been looking forward to taking this course and can confidently say she ruined it for me. I would take any other available professor for this course if at all possible.

Poor experience with this professor, shared by classmates. Seems more self-focused than student success-oriented. Exams graded harshly with no partial credit for minor errors. Difficult to interact with, turning an initially exciting elective into a disappointing experience. Advise against taking courses with her; better APMA professors availible.

I loved Professor Feitosa, and I will be taking another class with her next semester. Though there is a lot of homework, they're simple and pretty short. She's very caring and goes above and beyond for her students. Highly recommend if you're looking for a language to take at UVA.

Prof. Feitosa is very kind. She can be disorganized from time to time but she always makes up for any issues. She's very understanding and gives a lot of space for her student to learn. Although this class had A LOT of homework, she gave us all the time in the world to complete them. Definitely would recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment:
Did I get an A? Yes. Was it easy? Also yes. Would I EVER recommend this class to anyone? Absolutely not.
Worst teacher of my life.
-announces homework/exams HOURS before (often at 12-1 AM, with class at 11 next day)
-awful teaching, but blames students, has called us "failures"
-I've taken 2 semesters but learned NOTHING. Class is a waste of time.
